Product Title: Amazon.com: Apple iPhone 14, 128GB, Midnight - Unlocked (Renewed) : Cell Phones & Accessories
Review Title: It has the worst battery life of any iPhone I've ever owned, and I have owned ONLY iPhones since the
Review Content: It has the worst battery life of any iPhone I've ever owned, and I have owned ONLY iPhones since the first version was released 17 years ago. This is the second iPhone 14 that I've bought from the renewed store . The first one I bought on December 4th, 2023, and I could not have been happier with the phone. It arrived in brand new condition, and performed flawlessly. On the recommendation of a friend, I checked the battery health and charging after having it for MONTHS and it was at 100%! I was thrilled! Unfortunately, on July 30 of this year I dropped it, and it was beyond repair. I immediately went back to the Amazon renewed store and purchased another iPhone 14 because my experience with the first one was so fantastic. It arrived in new looking condition, exactly like the one I bought in December 2023. It was not scratched or anything really noticeable, it just seemed to be "worn" a little bit, but I fully understood that it was a renewed phone, and any cosmetic issues were not that important to me, including the color, which, when my iPhone is in its case, you cannot tell what color it is anyway. Unfortunately, I DID NOT look at the battery health and charging when I first got the phone 38 days ago, but I did look at it about two weeks ago, and it said 93%. I thought, ok, it's a renewed phone, it's not going to have 100% battery life. Well, I just looked at it today and it's now at 90% battery health and charging. I have it completely set up for optimized battery life. I have lost emails and messages that I was in the middle of composing, and the phone just dies. I've been in the middle of important phone calls when the phone dies, simply because I had just fully charged it a few hours before that, and thought I would be fine for hours to come. I just had a total shoulder replacement surgery a week ago, and I was on the phone with my doctors office yesterday about my first post-op appointment, and my phone died in the middle of it. I thought I had HOURS left before the phone would die. Then I had to plug it in, and wait for it to come back alive, so I could call my doctor back and hopefully not wait a half hour after losing my place in line. On top of that is also has issues with the touchscreen being glitchy, and sometimes I have to tap on things several times to get them to work. As I said, I have been an iPhone owner/user since the very first version came out 17 years ago. I've always loved all my iPhones, and I will continue to be an iPhone user for the rest of my life. This is in no way reflection on Apple iPhones whatsoever. They are an amazing and fantastic piece of technology. I think I just got a bad one for the first time in my life. Luckily, I have just checked and I have until November 6th to return this phone, and I WILL be returning it. Review Content: I originally got a Renewed/Refurbished iPhone 12, but the battery life was disappointing when compared to iPhone 6S Plus. I do not play games on my smartphones, so I don't care about it. 1. iPhone 13 is heavier and thicker than the iPhone 12. 2. I don't think the camera focus of either back lens is as sharp as the iPhone 6S Plus. It takes a long time to focus, especially for close-up shots, and boke is not reliable. Review Title: I needed a new phone fast after my cat knocked mine into the sink ☹️ Rice fixed it for a while, but
Review Content: I needed a new phone fast after my cat knocked mine into the sink ☹️ Rice fixed it for a while, but it was only temporary before it died altogether. I hate buying phones and avoid it whenever possible. 99% of mine belonged to someone in my family first. And i was good with that. Needless to say, my cat didn’t wait for someone in my family to upgrade. I was on my own this time. Okay.... that’s not entirely true. My grandma had an iPhone 7 sitting around so that held me over in the meantime. Going from an iPhone 11 Pro Max to an iPhone 7 was….bad. It was too dam small, in every possible way. 32 gigs of memory!! I needed an upgrade. Fast. My 11 year old was bullying me relentlessly. And that’s on me. They had my old XR (formerly my dad’s) I scoured FB marketplace. I’d decided upgrade a little, so I could feel better about the switch. I didn’t want to feel backed me into a corner by my cat’s recklessness. I would get a slightly newer model in a fun colour. Marketplace had plenty. Sending message after message from my iPhone 7, I worried. “This person seems too eager”, “this one has been posted so long”, “I want a purple, but the only purple one listed has less storage space” and “the pretty green one has a small crack”, “this guy lives 2 hours from me” and “Battery life? Errr last time I checked it was like 74%?….no, I can’t take a screenshot of it, it’s turned off”…. “cash only please” Etc. So much pressure. What happens if the thing doesn’t work? That’s $300+ down the drain. I knew I couldn’t afford new. But I hated the idea of buying something used from a stranger on Facebook. I didn’t want to get scammed, and I also didn’t want to settle. That’s when I remembered good ol’ Amazon. Maybe I’d check there. Just for funsies. Probably out of my budget, but it couldn’t hurt. Sure enough, refurbished devices selling “like new!” Mostly same cost or less than what I’d found so far. Surely there was a catch? I read through everything, tested by Amazon, includes all the specs, unlocked, I can pick the colour, the storage size, the condition, etc. AND I could have it delivered to me tomorrow??! With a warranty?!! I recovered from my brief stint of disappointment after learning the 12’s don’t come in yellow. Then fought hard to decide between mint and lavender. The lavender would take an extra day to arrive. Mint it was!! As promised, it arrived the next day. It was in beautiful shape. 128g’s, mint green, not a single scratch, 86% battery life. All for less than I would have paid to some stranger for a 64g with some “small scratches” Once my case and screen protector arrived I excitedly set it up and synced my data. After becoming used to facial recognition, having that yanked away, and dealing with a 7 for over 2 weeks— I was desperate for the convenience of Face ID. I had been using my fingerprint. Like a *caveman*. Not to mention I have Blink 182 tickets, and it specifically states facial recognition is required to access the mobile tickets. Idk if that’s true, but I needed Face ID!! I googled, I contacted apple support. Fixing it could be upwards of $300. That’s almost what I paid for the whole phone!! I realllllly didn’t want to be stuck without a phone again. But I also wanted one fully functioning. So I reached out to Amazon support and explained. The rep was incredibly helpful (as most Amazon reps are) and after bts failed, she advised the ship was a 3rd party seller, and she send a message to them. “If they don’t fix it by (insert date) contact us back and we’ll make this right” she encouraged. I’m ngl. I was nervous. I didn’t have high hopes, having dealt with 3p sellers on Amazon in the past. At least Amazon had my back, ig. The concert wasn’t till July. Even without facial recognition, it was loads better than the 7. I could make do in the meantime. The seller came in clutch though, and my worry was unwarranted. They responded within minutes. They were receptive, apologetic, and more than willing to help. As I’d anticipated, they offered a refund or exchange, as soon as they received the return. I explained my concern with not having a phone for several days or more; and the merchant offered to overnight a replacement as soon as the return was dropped off. I could deal with one day without a phone! I gratefully accepted. That was Saturday night, we made plans to catch up Monday for the return instructions and for them to overnight it. Monday I reached back out; and they were ready to ship, BUT they *had no more green….* 🫢 SHOCK THIS WAS A HUGE BUMMER.It’s silly I know, and the definition of *first world problems “.. but I mean…. My change of heart about this whole phone thing HINGED ON THE FUN COLOUR. Without it, I was just a person…out $350… because my cat was thirsty while I was watching YouTube while washing dishes. I needed a cool colour. Plus, I’d already gotten the matching case! Clear with mint green borders. It wasn’t even a fun blue… it was a dark, serious, navy blue. It was pretty and classy, but I wanted something fun. I even asked if he had any older models in yellow 😭😭 no luck, They told me they’d be restocking in a day or so. Still, no greens or purples came in. Ugh. Reality was setting in. I was going to have to settle. It was fine, I thought. At least it would be a fully functioning phone. No. I wasn’t ready to let go. They assured me I could take my time to decide, and I asked if we could wait another week in case one came in. If it didn’t, *then* I would choose from the options available. I messaged them Wednesday afternoon, bracing myself for the answer…. THEY GOT IN PURPLE! YAY. They sent a label, I dropped it off, sent a photo, and had my new phone the next morning. they’d said overnight shipping… but wow! I’d dropped off the return around 3pm, and had the replacement by noon the next day. I didn’t even have my new case yet 😅 Despite the Barney-Esque colour scheme my mint green case created, the lavender is GORGEOUS and I’m actually sort of glad the green didn’t work out. Don’t get me wrong, the green is also gorgeous.. but in the end I’m glad I ended up with the lavender. I was overjoyed when I was prompted to set Face ID during setup. Worked brilliantly, as did everything else. Great packaging, no cosmetic flaws, amazing battery life, customer service was great, and best of all… ITS PURPLE! Can’t wait to pair it with the new case. I’m so glad I went this route where I have some peace of mind as a buyer. I’m grateful to the seller for being so helpful and patient with me as insufferable as I must have seemed making such a fuss over colour preference If you’re nervous buying a phone used or refurbished too, hopefully you can take comfort in knowing- this seller is legit. You receive a good quality product, and, speaking from experience, they’ll gladly help resolve any issues you may run into. Product Title: Amazon.com: Apple AirPods Pro - 1st Gen (Renewed) : Electronics
Review Title: However, this is the first time I’ve ever purchased a used/refurbished/ renewed pair
Review Content: However, this is the first time I’ve ever purchased a used/refurbished/ renewed pair. But since I lose them all the time, I thought it may be a cost effective option for me. Unfortunately, my device was defective out of the box! My Airpods Pro didn’t come with all of the materials that come in the original box and the charger I received [packaged separately] was not even an apple brand. This didn’t bother me much, as I have more than enough accessories for this item. The device itself appeared clean and undamaged. When I opened the device to check the battery status, it was dead [Apple has a policy of not sending their devices fully charged for shipping safety reasons, so I assumed the previous owner received the item new and returned them without charging it more]. I connected the airpods to my OFFICIAL Apple charger from a previous device and the battery light immediately glowed green. Confused, I then proceeded to pair it to my phone. The first attempt was successful. I checked my battery notification screen on my iPhone and the airpods case displayed a full 100% charge, yet the airpods themselves were each dead at 1%. After a few seconds of charge, they reached 7% [charging speed rare, but not completely unheard of], so I took the case off the charger and went to test out the sound quality. As soon as I took an earpiece out- the entire device went off. The case and pods still read as charging on my phone even though I had removed them from charging moments before. I could not find the devise in my drop menu, so I went into settings to manually pair the AirPods again- but they wouldn’t sync. After 4/5 times connecting and forgetting device, I attempted to reattach the charger- NOW the AirPods case is on 0% but the earpieces are both on 13% 🙄. As soon as I plug them back in, the airpods sync again and I am able to hear the pairing chime on my earpiece. SECONDS LATER the airpods die and the phone shows they are on 0% *charging* WHILE they are still in my ears! Like I said, I’ve had a ton of airpods, I know how to troubleshoot most any problem they give me. I’ve never had to deal with this kind of headache before- ESPECIALLY on day 1. I’m so over it! I’m going to an Apple store first thing in the morning. This was a horrible experience. Review Title: I bought this for one main, directed purpose: to use Sonos' TruePlay function to calibrate my old So
Review Content: I bought this for one main, directed purpose: to use Sonos' TruePlay function to calibrate my old Sonos system after a major move (the TruePlay is only available on iOS), At the time, I was also considering using it as a "home remote" kind of thing instead of cluttering up my main phone, but pretty much the only role has been my main go-to interface for Sonos as well as being a 2nd eSim home phone. I prefer keeping my main cell phone on mute whenever I am home (lots of junk calls), but for those calls I really, really want to always catch, particularly my bosses (lol), I decided to activate a line through this phone. Since the thing is always home, usually by my bedside while my main phone is in the living room, charging, it nicely fits the desire. Only had to use it a few times as an actual phone, but no issues. I did buy a MagSafe case (pretty cheap) and use my Ugreen Magsafe charger for it. Works a charm every time. No issues with anything at all, in fact. It functions without problems or hiccupping irritations... yet, again, this isn't a workhorse for me, but a QOL convenience. So yes, my usage probably doesn't mirror most, yet for those who are looking just for a lowkey, hang-about 2nd smartphone without breaking the bank (or contract), I am quite happy with it. It lets me sleep knowing that if I hear a phone ringing, it's going to be something *very* important about the lab. Product Title: Amazon.com: Apple AirPods Pro (2nd Generation) (Renewed) : Electronics
Review Title: So, when I received these, I did not imagine it being boxed nicely
Review Content: So, when I received these, I did not imagine it being boxed nicely. But was I dead wrong. When I opened the Amazon packaging, I saw an Apple AirPods Pro boxed sealed and in pristine condition. I unwrapped it and opened the box and it was like opening a box for a pair of brand new AirPods. Everything down to the cable was properly placed and the headphones along with the case didn’t even look like they had been touched! AND THESE ARE RENEWED! It’s like I bought a pair brand new for less amount of money. A4C Online is absolutely amazing for how they packaged this product and the condition of these renewed AirPods Pro is beyond my belief. I truly didn’t expect the quality I received. As for the headphones themselves, jaw dropping amazement. From the noise cancellation, to the quality of the headphones, it’s all amazing. The noise cancellation is beyond belief. I set these up, put them in my ears while I listened to my fan, and turned on noise cancellation. Boom. The sound of the fan disappeared, like magic! The noise cancellation doesn’t block out every loud noise like movies, but it’s much better than anything I’ve ever used. Transparency is wonderful and definitely allows me to hear around me while I still listen to the music or video I’m listening to. I’m not sure if their are better headphones out there that do transparency better, but seeing how I’ve never seen headphones have this kind of feature, it’s definitely one of the reasons I bought these, especially so I can be at work and keep both headphones in without having to just leave one in so I may listen to what’s around me. The sound quality is crystal clear and makes me hear more of the music than I ever thought I could. The spatial sound turns music into a surround sound experience that was way better than I expected. The spatial sound was a little hard to setup, but that may just be because I’m an idiot. May take a few times, but you’ll get it eventually if you have the same problems I had. So far using these headphones, the only bad thing I can say about them is that the bass might be a little lower than I expected? But it’s not a big deal to me as I enjoy more of the quality of the sound rather than heavy bass, so if you really need to have heavy bass in your headphones, these might not be for you. As for the battery life, I haven’t had them long enough to know how well they are especially since these are also renewed. Thank you A4C Online for these wonderful headphones. I still cannot believe these are renewed headphones and am so glad I bought these from you! Thanks again. If you’re looking for a pair of AirPod Pros, you’re definitely making the right choice buying from them. The battery life is quite decent. After about 4 or 5 hours the battery life will drop to about 75%. Much more than I expected from a renewed product. Transparency is not as affective as I had originally thought. I have to turn down my music if I want to be able to hear anyone else. I wish they made it so you could increase the transparency to be louder otherwise I have to keep my music down low. Otherwise an excellent product still and I recommend buying these renewed AirPods.       [Read more Read less](javascript:void(0))

(I ordered another pair to see if every pair had that issue, but the second pair worked fine.) So I tried returning the first pair that was defective. Amazon was helpful in starting the return process, and I returned the AirPods in the same condition in which I received them. However, I NEVER got a refund. It's been 4 months. I called Customer Service 5 separate times, and each time they instructed me to fill out an appeal form. I did this multiple times, and even a couple customer service agents issued appeals from their end. But nothing came of it. With each appeal, I received an automated response saying that they can't issue a refund because they received a damaged item, but that's exactly why I returned it in the first place! They said I returned the item in a different condition than I received it, which is untrue and I've wasted hours trying to explain this but the customer service agents can't do anything about it. I'm not sure if it got damaged along the way back or if the people who process returns are just too unwilling to admit they've made a mistake. But either way, Amazon received my product worth $162.18, and I never saw a penny of the refund. They essentially stole from me by not holding up their end of the return deal, and not even offering to send the product back to me. This makes me very wary to order from Amazon Renewed again, and quite frustrated at their unwillingness to understand. Amazon, you are sitting on trillions of dollars. I don't care what budget it comes from, but I'd appreciate if you could spare $162.18 to one long-time customer who really wants to keep believing that Amazon has great customer service. Please make this right. NOTE: If I hear back from Amazon and get a full refund, I will edit my review to reflect the good pair I got instead of this bad experience... not to mention have my faith in their refund policy restored. Review Title: Next, the quality of the AirPods
Review Content: Next, the quality of the AirPods. They sound amazing. According to the app on the iPhone the large tips work best with my ears and form the best seal. I paid $171 for this refurbished set and that deal is amazing for what you get. The build quality makes me feel that with a little care these will last for years in my ears. Review Title: First and foremost, the sound quality of the AirPods Pro 2nd Gen is outstanding
Review Content: First and foremost, the sound quality of the AirPods Pro 2nd Gen is outstanding. The audio is crisp, clear, and immersive, allowing me to fully appreciate my favorite music, podcasts, and movies. The active noise cancellation feature is a game-changer, effectively blocking out unwanted background noise and allowing me to focus on what I'm listening to. The transparency mode is also impressive, seamlessly blending the surrounding sounds with my audio for enhanced awareness. Comfort is another area where the AirPods Pro excel. The earbuds come with three different sizes of silicone tips, allowing for a customized and secure fit. They sit comfortably in my ears, and I can wear them for extended periods without any discomfort. The lightweight design adds to the overall comfort, making them a pleasure to use throughout the day. The integration with the Apple ecosystem is seamless and convenient. Setting up the AirPods Pro with my iPhone was a breeze, and the automatic pairing and connection feature is incredibly convenient. The earbuds intelligently switch between my devices, whether it's my iPhone, iPad, or MacBook, ensuring a seamless transition without any manual intervention. Additionally, the hands-free "Hey Siri" functionality is a game-changer, allowing me to control my music or make calls with just my voice. Battery life is impressive on the AirPods Pro. They provide around 4.5 hours of continuous listening time, and with the charging case, I can extend it to more than 24 hours. The quick charging feature is a lifesaver, providing me with about an hour of listening time with just a 5-minute charge. This is perfect for those times when I'm in a hurry and need a quick boost of battery power. Choosing the refurbished option for the AirPods Pro 2nd Gen was a great decision. They look and function like new, and I appreciate the cost savings compared to buying them brand new. Apple's refurbishing process ensures that the product meets high standards, and I haven't experienced any issues or concerns with the refurbished pair I received. In terms of convenience, the AirPods Pro's wireless charging case is a game-changer. It allows me to charge the earbuds effortlessly using Qi-compatible wireless chargers, eliminating the need for cables and making charging a hassle-free experience. The case itself is compact and easy to carry, protecting the earbuds when not in use. Overall, I am thoroughly impressed with the Apple AirPods Pro 2nd Gen (Refurbished). Their exceptional sound quality, comfortable fit, seamless integration, and convenient features make them a top-tier wireless earbud option. Whether you're an Apple enthusiast or simply looking for a premium audio experience, these refurbished AirPods Pro deliver on all fronts. Don't hesitate to get your hands on them and enjoy a truly immersive and wireless listening experience. Product Title: Amazon.com: Apple iPhone 11, 64GB, Black - Unlocked (Renewed) : Cell Phones & Accessories
Review Title: ##### Better Than I Expected for a Refurbished Phone
Review Content: ##### Better Than I Expected for a Refurbished Phone I picked this up as a backup phone, so I wasn’t expecting it to be perfect. Since it’s an older model, I figured it would probably have some scratches or small dents, but nope... this baby was in way better shape than I expected. The screen looked really good, and I had to actually look closely to find any signs that it had been used. I did put a screen protector and case on it right away because, once I saw the condition it came in, I wanted to keep it that way. Another impressive thing was how easy it was to get everything set up. It powered on with no issues, and transferring my stuff from my old phone was pretty simple. Everything has been running smoothly so far, and I haven’t noticed any overheating, even while setting it up, downloading apps, and using it for a while. And oh man, talk about the screen size. It’s big enough for browsing, watching videos, and reading without making the phone feel huge or awkward to hold. The phone size is actually pretty comfortable, and it still feels durable enough for everyday use. The battery life is not the same as a brand-new iPhone, but that’s expected with a refurbished phone. It still gets me through a normal day, which is really all I needed. For the price and the condition it came in, I’d say it was a solid deal. [More](javascript:void(0))[Hide](javascript:void(0)) There was a problem filtering reviews. Please reload the page.

Review Title: They came to me in a small cardboard box that was unmarked
Review Content: They came to me in a small cardboard box that was unmarked. Fine, I get it they were refurbished. But not even a little bit of bubble wrap to keep them broom banging around the entire time they were in transit? I work for fed ex I know how stuff gets knocked around. Came with a charger cord which is cool except it was a usb-c and I ordered a pair of lightning port AirPods sooooo yeah. The sound quality was what you would expect if you took a tin can, tied a string to it and had someone scream into it from another tin can tied to the other end of the string. I tried to have a conversation with my husband and he could register approximately one out of every 4 words I said. When he spoke, it sounded like he had a mouthful of dry crackers. So the sound quality was trash. None of the controls on the pods worked. Volume? Nope. One push mute? Also nope. I went into the app to make sure *I* wasn’t the problem and also nope. So that was a fail. The battery also was terrible. Two hours max per pod. This is my third set of pods (I’m on my phone A LOT) and I’ve never seen battery deplete so quickly. Not only that but there was NO WARNING before they just died. Normally you get two heads up warnings that your battery is depleting. Not so with this pair. After 2 hours of use just BOOM dead. So mid conversation I had to scramble to remember where I had left my phone or while I was at work I had to stop what I was doing to change out the pod. Just a mess all around. I had gotten a refurb phone so I thought this would be a great way to save a little bit of cash while also cutting down on electronics waste but this was just trash from one end to the other. And let’s not forget the return procedure. It used to be a simple act of taking them to one of the return places in my area. Drop them off, get my money back. Simple. Now, I have to box them up, print a label and BE HOME for UPS to come get them. What a headache, since as I said I work for fed ex M-F. I’m heading to Best Buy to get a new pair of these and give myself a break from this whole trashy experience. Review Title: Let me first state the bad experience I dealt with this watch
Review Content: Let me first state the bad experience I dealt with this watch. When I first received this watch came with some random “smart watch” box doesn’t come with the original Apple box, it also comes with 2 cheap unofficial Apple products which is a charger and wrist band. I’ve heard in the reviews the chargers don’t charge properly with this Apple Watch and it’s true it doesn’t and the band breaks easily, luckily I had an actual solid charger to charge this watch since it also came straight up dead no charge at all, so I was like “okay no big deal” just let it charge for a few mins Apple Watches should always charge quick as they say. 5 mins passes by the watch finally turns on and I was looking to pair it with my phone, it was going well until it was time to update and I left it there so it can update there was like 2 updates to this Apple Watch so i let the first update go, and it just kept repeating and repeating like it was not updating so I had to literally stay on my watch and see it update but it took SOO LONG it was pissing me off until it finally did the first update now the second update required my phone to stay at least 50% charge or it can stay on the charger while it update. So I did that, I let my watch sit on the charge and it kept telling me AGAIN to make sure my watch is at least on 50% charge or stay on the charger while updating but none of that worked at all meaning my watch was on the charger and it still kept telling me to keep it charged if it’s not at least 50%, so I left it there for at least 20 minutes. 20 minutes passes by and it’s barely 20%!!! I was already looking to refunding this watch already and while it was charging I was looking at reviews having the same issue. Finally 1 hour and 20 minutes it’s 50% and the second update started thank goodness, when everything was done I finally paired it to my phone but battery was not good at all so I was still thinking on refunding this watch since I had to spend more on battery change. But what can I say the watch was smooth, screen and edges were clean clean no damage but my issue was just the battery but I had faith in this watch so I just kept it. After a week of wearing this watch, the battery slowly started getting solid, it charges quicker now first time I charged it yes it did heat up a lot but it’s normal after all the updates it received and to this day no it doesn’t heat that much no more in fact after charging it all night the next morning my watch is on 100% cool not heated up and lasts longer. After a 12 hour shift the battery still is holding at 80% I was shocked at the performance and the watch itself is just beautiful, Siri worked, my calls went through. Though this is still a risk on buying since not everybody has the same performance, I’m guessing my watch was just not updated and turned on for a while that i received a bad experience the first time I got it. I’d say stay patience and see it slowly work. Sorry, we failed to record your vote. Please try again Sorry, We failed to report this review. Please try again

Review Title: As a real hearing aid, something to hear others talk? For me, worthless
Review Content: As a real hearing aid, something to hear others talk? For me, worthless. I hear people better when I take them out. For that I should give 1 or 2 star rating. I hoped while my reg hearings were being repaired these would get me by. Nope. But. The sound quality for TV, computer, phone, and MUSIC! GREAT! I can enjoy music again. Our pellet stove is 8 feet away and noisy. The noise suppression all but blocks it out. The set up was super easy. I had my audiologist print out my hearing chart, or lack of hearing chart, took a pic with my I-phone, it quickly programed the Airpods and suddenly Janis Joplin sounded good again! Outside noise is blocked. I tried every ear pad that came with this and find the fit, ehh, so so. I have to be careful or they fall out. Left ear hurts after a half hour or so. Not the inner ear, but where it pushes on the cartridge. Getting used to it. Why did I keep them? Because of the sound quality when I do use them. Oh, and whoever designed the case after a greased water melon seed should be beat with something slick and hard to hold on to. A little embossed pattern on the case would have done a lot. And a better latch. If you drop these even a few inches the lid opens and the Airpods make a dash for the door. Dam near dropped one in the toilet. Caught it just in time. Luckily many aftermarket cases out there. And of course in Apple's weird system, a charger wasn't included and it takes a different one than my I-phone. Luckily I found one that fit and ordered a couple more. Youtube videos for how to set up are a must. I do have issues switching between my reg hearing aids and these, but usually not too bad. One time it's automatic, next time I'm in settings on my phone. But really not a big deal. Would be 5 star if they stayed in my ear and actually worked as a low grade hearing aid. But worth it for everything else. By programming like a hearing aid, sound quality is great!!! And blocking background noise is very nice. Might save on marriage counseling by not hearing each other. Review Title: The screen size was larger than the iPhone 8, even though the chassis was smaller
Review Content: The screen size was larger than the iPhone 8, even though the chassis was smaller. It was weird moving to a device without a home button, but I got used to it quickly. The cameras are pretty good, and hold up well especially with more modern phones. The size is amazing. It's super convenient to use one handed, and it's so light compared to other phones. You can often forget you even have it on you. The 256GB version has lasted me forever. I'm still barely at around 100gb of usage, and I do take a large amount of photographs on it. It has gained quite a few scratches, especially around the cameras or on the edges of the frame. It is a 6-year-old phone however, so while the exist they're nothing more than cosmetic issues. Charges fairly well, the age of the device does mean that charging can cause it to overheat. Battery life itself isn't great either. I luckily have it charging periodically throughout the day, but with minimal usage you'll still barely get back to bed with about 20% left sometimes. Definitely invest in a battery replacement if you're considering going with one of these. Asides from that it's a pretty good purchase. Lasted me from 2023 until 2026. They may potentially drop support on the mini, so if you're worried about that then potentially aim for the 13 mini instead. Review Title: Unfortunately, the Amazon warranty is only three months
Review Content: Unfortunately, the Amazon warranty is only three months. (I thought it was one year because other competitors offer that. But it does clearly say on their page that it’s only three months.) During these three months, they to completely refund you no problem or fix the issue that you report. But unfortunately the phone I kept died on month four, while I was on vacation to make matters worse. Seems like the sellers are always different stores, but all amazon approved and they follow some sort of Amazon standards for these phones. But it seems to me that these phones have really severe issues so these Amazon sellers fix the phones to a certain standard, but they are not in good condition. All the sellers are polite and responsive, but the issue is the actual phones and their conditions. Even though these phones are used, they are not cheap, they should function properly. I’ve been an Amazon customer for years and I really haven’t had any issue with them. That was the reason why I decided to buy the used phone on Amazon instead of a competitor. But this is truly disappointing to the point that I think I’m going to report them to the Better Business Bureau. They should not be selling phones in this condition. When I receive the phone physically it seems fine. But as soon as I put a case on it, a lot of little pieces of paint started coming off of it and then you could tell it had a lot of scratches on the case so somebody was trying to cover the scratches, then I put a screen protector on it, and after trying to I could not get rid of a humongous huge bubble, took a third of the screen. So some thing was hinting to me that the screen was not straight. In my opinion, the phone shouldn’t have been sold as good condition with so many scratches but since I don’t care about the look as much as functionality, I move forward. But then, after a few weeks of using the phone, I realized things were not working properly. The camera was very slow at taking pictures if it was dark or if you were using inside the message or WhatsApp. Also, if I received a text while listening to videos or video calls, the speaker would suddenly gets super low, and I could barely hear the video for about two minutes . (usually this lowering of audio feature happens only for five or 10 seconds). This was worrying me so I contacted the seller and told him I wanted to change the phone and he said no problem. Since I was still thinking that this was bad luck, but in general, I liked the iPhone 12 I decided to buy another phone as a replacement, and one more phone as a Christmas gift. I’ll explain below the problems with those phones, but since the problems were actually worse than the current first phone I had in my possession, I never gave back this phone. I kept thinking that maybe the issues would get better with update and also, in my mind, I thought I had a year warranty. Unfortunately, in February while away on vacation the phone one morning, simply never turned on again. My dad is an engineer and he tried helping me connect it to computer and nothing it’s like the battery is no longer connected. I’m sure you can imagine the horrendous time I had the following week without my phone., traveling.. Things got worse when I got home and was able to contact the seller. I then discovered the warranty was only 90 days and that date had passed. After some back-and-forth the seller Kojak sales said they can fix it for $39 and I pay for shipping. Review Title: I inspected it
Review Content: I inspected it. There are wear marks on the case and crown but the face was fine. I put a screen and case protector on it and it looks fine. I checked the battery life and it’s down to 85%. I’m sure that’s going to be fine. I know it can be replaced it I want to later. The sports band is not an Apple product but I don’t care. I quit buying Apple Watch bands years ago. I can buy 3 or 4 of these perfectly fine knockoffs for the price of one Apple. Other than the scuffs and battery it works as it should. Down with overpriced stuff and thumbs up for cheaper rebuilt semi quality stuff. Kinda like a rebuilt transmission. As for the functionality of the watch, it's fine except for the battery life. I have to charge it part way through the day IF I want it to last all day. On more than one occasion, by 4:00 pm, I got the 10% battery left message and then it is dead until I get it on a charger. Now, I'm going to have to spend $100 to get the battery replaced. AND - the watch charger that came with it, does not work. Yes, I took the piece of plastic off of it before trying it out. I'm beginning to regret my purchase. I guess I could see if I can replace the battery myself but I don't want to perform surgery on a piece of electronics at my age. The battery will be around $25 and the tool kit will be around $30 plus shipping and handling. Still saving money though. Maybe I can start a side hustle replacing apple watch batteries and save enough to go on vacation in the tropics or buy a small can of pineapple juice. Found a video tutorial that walked me through turning off a number of the functions of the watch to save on battery. I am pleased to report that after doing that, I can now wear it 10 or 11 hours and the watch will still have mid 70's battery left. I shouldn't have to do this but I did so Now I can wear it and not worry about taking a charger to work with me so I can charge it over my lunch break. Product Title: Amazon.com: Apple iPhone 14 Pro Max, 128GB, Space Black - Unlocked (Renewed) : Cell Phones & Accessories
Review Title: Unfortunately, the phone I received was nowhere near "Excellent
Review Content: Unfortunately, the phone I received was nowhere near "Excellent." The biggest issue is the camera system. One of the main reasons I chose the iPhone 14 Pro Max was for its three-camera setup. However, only one camera works properly in Photo mode. In Video mode, two cameras work, while the third doesn't work at all. The 0.5x ultra-wide camera is completely unavailable, and the 5x zoom function doesn't work either. This is especially frustrating because I'm an up-and-coming mechanic, and I regularly use the 0.5x camera to take photos in tight spaces while working on customers' vehicles. It's an important tool for my job, not just a feature I wanted. I upgraded from an iPhone 13 Pro Max where two of the cameras had failed, so I was excited to finally have a phone with all three cameras working. Instead, I ended up with another phone that has camera issues. At that point, I could have saved money by buying an iPhone 14 Plus with only two cameras and probably received a phone that actually worked. Another concern was that the phone was not properly factory reset. The packaging states that Amazon Renewed devices are supposed to be factory reset before being resold. However, when I powered it on, it started up like a normal phone instead of taking me through the initial setup process. It appeared the previous owner had simply signed out of their Apple ID rather than the phone being completely erased and reset. I contacted Amazon Customer Support to request a replacement since the phone was defective. I was told there were no more iPhone 14 Pro Max devices in Excellent condition available to send as a replacement. However, when I checked the same Amazon listing, it still showed the exact same phone in Excellent condition available for purchase. I don't understand why replacements weren't available when the listing indicated more were in stock. I would have been happy to return the defective phone in exchange for a properly functioning one. I understand that Amazon Renewed products are used, and I wasn't expecting a brand-new phone. However, I did expect to receive the condition I paid for and a device with all advertised features working correctly. A phone with a partially functioning camera system should never pass inspection as "Excellent," especially when customers are paying a premium for that condition. Overall, this experience was extremely disappointing. Amazon Renewed is supposed to give customers confidence that devices have been inspected and tested. Based on my experience, the inspection process failed, and customer service did not provide a reasonable solution. I’m super observant and I’m on my phone 24/7 so I can tell the screen does a little bit of flickering but I believe that’s bc is a refurbished phone??? Idk again maybe my eyes are deceiving me, I’m not too picky because the phone does meet my needs and the customer service was great and the phone overall came in great condition as well. And after a while I forget about it and literally don’t notice it at all, so I’m okay. Back to customer service I reached out a few days before I received the phone and the seller answered the questions I had. They were a little vague but my questions were answered. I have a pretty long time to make a final decision and return the phone if that’s what the future entails. But to be completely honest I am satisfied with my purchase. And I’d give it a 8.5/10! Product Title: Amazon.com: Apple iPhone 14 Pro, 256GB, Space Black - Unlocked (Renewed) : Cell Phones & Accessories
Review Title: It was a lovely phone, in outstanding cosmetic condition - it appeared brand new
Review Content: It was a lovely phone, in outstanding cosmetic condition - it appeared brand new. The seller was also very gracious to include a screen protector, and I have no complaints regarding the seller, delivery, or customer service. It functioned perfectly when it first arrived, with no glitches and an easy transfer process. I was not satisfied with the camera; I am uncertain if this is a characteristic of the iPhone 14, but I do not believe the photo quality surpasses that of my previous phone, which was an iPhone 12. I expected it to produce higher quality images, but perhaps it was returned for refurbishment due to the camera issues? After 2-3 weeks, the phone started to shut down unexpectedly, even when fully charged, and when it powered back on after a few seconds, it would show only 10% battery life? This was peculiar. The battery health was reported to be at 90%, which I found surprising, but later discovered that this percentage can be manipulated to reflect better battery health, even if that is not the reality. Aside from the random shutdowns, my phone required charging every 3 hours, and within 2 weeks, the battery health dropped from 90% to 80%. It would have been an amazing deal and worth the money for a 1TB phone in great exterior condition , and I’m sad I had to return it . I could not handle the random shut downs and constant charging and the photo quality was also a big factor (it might just have been my phone and not all iPhone 14’s). I’m bummed! But return was easy & just a friendly reminder that whenever you do drop off a pricey item like this for returns, get a print out of the receipt ! Had nothing to do with my return , just throwing it out there. Review Title: Needed to replace an aging IPhone which was still working great, but a lot of apps needing newer IOS
Review Content: Needed to replace an aging IPhone which was still working great, but a lot of apps needing newer IOS. So, not looking for the lastest/greatest, just a good update. Decided IPh 14+ was a good option. 1) I purchased an “Excellent” OPEN BOX phone from Best Buy. It came in a box sealed with Geek Squad tape. When opened, the phone had tons of fingerprints all over it, front and back; not a great first impression. After going through the startup process I was greeted with a screen that informed me that the phone had remote management software installed on it. Basically unusable. 2) I returned it and they replaced it with another “Excellent” OPEN BOX. Same thing – both phones had been previously owned by some company (now out of business) who had loaded remote management software on the phones. So… these are expensive, unusable bricks, and shame on BB/Geek Squad for selling these phones to the public. 3) After that experience I decided to give Amazon a try and bought a phone supplied by WOOT, as I have had good experiences with other Woot purchases. The phone arrived in a beat up generic box with the inside packaging worse than the outside. On the positive side, the phone was cosmetically very good with no obvious scratches, etc. So, everything looked good until I checked the battery health. 81%. NOT GOOD. Yes, it meets the described spec of >80% for their “Excellent” condition, but will going to be into the Apple service condition in a couple of weeks. Returned to Amazon/Woot and waiting for refund. After reading a ton of reviews I decided to give it one more shot and get a “Premium” condition directly from Amazon.com. Most of the reviews of these phones were much better than all of the other vendors. They are definitely more expensive but come with a 365 day warranty vs 90 day and spec at >90% battery life. Phone arrived today. It was VERY nicely packaged in a SEALED shrink wrapped professional looking box. Opened the box and found a phone with what appeared to be the original Apple protective film still in place on the front and back. Battery was dead so after a quick charge I was able to check battery health…… 100% and 0 charge cycles. Basically this is a brand NEW, NEVER USED phone. I can’t say how impressed I was after three bad experiences. I saved a couple $hundred compared to BB or Apple and got a brand new phone ….. It’s all about the journey  !!! Review Title: I am a Doctor and made the decision to give this purchase a try, spending nearly $1000
Review Content: I am a Doctor and made the decision to give this purchase a try, spending nearly $1000.00 for a used iPhone 16-plus Max, trust me I was very skeptical too say the least! Let me tell you I had it delivered on time, my husband was out in the yard when delivery came , they were asking for a password which we didn’t have, we were told to check Amazon on my phone, I went inside got my phone and checked on Amazon Prime and there was the code gave to deliver person and signed for package. That was Late on Sunday afternoon about 4:30, i brought it ( I initially hid it away out of sight of my spouse) I did so because I knew he would be furious that I’d spend $1000.00 on a used phone, today’s Wednesday three days later, I went on and called my carrier and had it added to my phone account prior to doing that, I unboxed it and to my utter surprise it was amazing. Not a scratch that I could see you on the screen anywhere, I checked the left side, the right side, even the back as you can see from the attached photos that I am attaching. It was brand new, or look to be brand new had no problems, I own an iPhone 12 plus Max and I had a Samsung note 9 already, I had them take the note 9 off and add the 16+ Max . I am happy, across the board with everything. It came very well packaged in a box as you can see, I put photo of the box it came in, if you’re on the fence about this don’t be. I’m telling you I could not be happier. I’ll come back here in a couple weeks and update everyone on how it’s working, I can tell you this it is up-to-date technology now is quite different, unlike when I did my iPhone 12 max plus, I had to get on the phone with my provider and it took about maybe 45-minutes to do everything . when I opened the box and looked at it. I set it down not thinking next to my iPhone 12 plus, I had no ideal anything would happen till I heard it kind of vibration , when I picked up the phone to look at it it was everything had transferred cause they were only sitting on the table while I went and did something else in the house so, when I come back, I could see the picture of my dog on the front of the new phone and I was like wow what happened if I didn’t know better I would’ve been like it’s gonna take me 45 minutes to an hour and that’s really why it took me three days to open it up, I just did not have time to deal with carrier and Technician for support, and all that drama with cloud and transferring data to one phone from the other. I just did not have the time to get on the phone with the (carrier) and go through all the Rigamarole so to speak . Let me tell you when I saw the dog picture on the new phone. I picked it up and I dialed my husband‘s number and it worked already which was amazing. I still called the carrier and told them and they were like what’s happening is it’s ringing from your iPhone 12+ it automatically because it’s two iPhones everything transfer over and from the note 9 so I didn’t have to do anything, but took me about maybe 10 minutes and that’s cause their system was slow to have them take the phone number off the note 9 and move it to the new iPhone 16+ and then they call me and checked everything and everything was operating fine. I am so happy again if you are on the fence, take a chance you know how great Amazon prime is. If you buy something you don’t like it you could send it back. I am tremendously pleased with this purchase, check out the photos. UPDATE: It’s exactly 2-months later after purchasing this I-Phone 16 Pro-Max, This is the best purchase Ever that I have made on Amazon as far as electronics goes, I told you how pleased I was initially with it and promised an update well…. I am even more happier now that I have had 2-months to try it out , let me tell you it is even better now, I’ve learned to navigate it because there was some differences between my 12 & this 16, as far as how it operates and what button does what but I am Loving this phone guys it is Amazing so very glad I took a chance and bought it! Let me tell you I had it delivered on time, my husband was out in the yard when delivery came , they were asking for a password which we didn’t have, we were told to check Amazon on my phone, I went inside got my phone and checked on Amazon Prime and there was the code gave to deliver person and signed for package. That was Late on Sunday afternoon about 4:30, i brought it ( I initially hid it away out of sight of my spouse) I did so because I knew he would be furious that I’d spend $1000.00 on a used phone, today’s Wednesday three days later, I went on and called my carrier and had it added to my phone account prior to doing that, I unboxed it and to my utter surprise it was amazing. Not a scratch that I could see you on the screen anywhere, I checked the left side, the right side, even the back as you can see from the attached photos that I am attaching. It was brand new, or look to be brand new had no problems, I own an iPhone 12 plus Max and I had a Samsung note 9 already, I had them take the note 9 off and add the 16+ Max . I am happy, across the board with everything. It came very well packaged in a box as you can see, I put photo of the box it came in, if you’re on the fence about this don’t be. I’m telling you I could not be happier. I’ll come back here in a couple weeks and update everyone on how it’s working, I can tell you this it is up-to-date technology now is quite different, unlike when I did my iPhone 12 max plus, I had to get on the phone with my provider and it took about maybe 45-minutes to do everything . when I opened the box and looked at it. I set it down not thinking next to my iPhone 12 plus, I had no ideal anything would happen till I heard it kind of vibration , when I picked up the phone to look at it it was everything had transferred cause they were only sitting on the table while I went and did something else in the house so, when I come back, I could see the picture of my dog on the front of the new phone and I was like wow what happened if I didn’t know better I would’ve been like it’s gonna take me 45 minutes to an hour and that’s really why it took me three days to open it up, I just did not have time to deal with carrier and Technician for support, and all that drama with cloud and transferring data to one phone from the other. I just did not have the time to get on the phone with the (carrier) and go through all the Rigamarole so to speak . Let me tell you when I saw the dog picture on the new phone. I picked it up and I dialed my husband‘s number and it worked already which was amazing. I still called the carrier and told them and they were like what’s happening is it’s ringing from your iPhone 12+ it automatically because it’s two iPhones everything transfer over and from the note 9 so I didn’t have to do anything, but took me about maybe 10 minutes and that’s cause their system was slow to have them take the phone number off the note 9 and move it to the new iPhone 16+ and then they call me and checked everything and everything was operating fine. I am so happy again if you are on the fence, take a chance you know how great Amazon prime is. If you buy something you don’t like it you could send it back. I am tremendously pleased with this purchase, check out the photos. UPDATE: It’s exactly 2-months later after purchasing this I-Phone 16 Pro-Max, This is the best purchase Ever that I have made on Amazon as far as electronics goes, I told you how pleased I was initially with it and promised an update well…. I am even more happier now that I have had 2-months to try it out , let me tell you it is even better now, I’ve learned to navigate it because there was some differences between my 12 & this 16, as far as how it operates and what button does what but I am Loving this phone guys it is Amazing so very glad I took a chance and bought it! Product Title: Amazon.com: Apple iPhone (Renewed Premium) 16 Pro Max, US Version, 256GB, Desert Titanium - Unlocked : Cell Phones & Accessories
Review Title: When I got the package in the mail I hesitated even opening the box and contemplated just returning
Review Content: When I got the package in the mail I hesitated even opening the box and contemplated just returning it back without giving it a chance. Well, after opening the box and charging it up, I transferred my data over to the iPhone 16 Pro Max and it worked well and fairly easy too. I still wasn’t too impressed with the iPhone just yet, but I gave it a chance. As I began using it and saw the battery life was at 98 % I thought, WOW, nice iPhone with a pretty decent battery too. I also noticed it still has an Apple warranty until March of 2026. The phone is beautiful and works great thus far, but my niece said I should get the iPhone 17 Pro Max. So I looked it up and didn’t see why I should go into a 2k debt for an iPhone 17 pro max with a 1 terabyte storage drive. After all, my iPhone 16 Pro Max still gets another 6 years of updates on the iOS software. I have to say I still have time to return this iPhone, but, right now, this is a well made and solid purchase and I feel very comfortable with it after 2 weeks of use. I still have my android Galaxy S25 Ultra, and I’m gonna keep it too, but the seller of this iPhone certainly does ship out beautiful and quality iPhones to the buyers. No scratches or dings and a great battery life too. The item arrived with great packaging and I am impressed with this seller. Now my niece with the iPhone 17 pro max with 256 gig of storage loves her phone, she’s had it for about a month now, and yes,she paid more than me and I have a 1 terabyte storage drive on mine, and her first complaint about the iPhone 17 is, the aluminum casing gets scratched up easily forcing her to get a cover so she doesn’t have to look at the scratched up case on her new iPhone. The IPhone 16 Pro Max has a titanium frame that is solid, and I do have a case over it to protect it from drops or falls. Would I recommend this iPhone and seller on Amazon. ABSOLUTELY YES! Review Title: I ordered my iPhone 16 pro max couple of days back and got it yesterday
Review Content: I ordered my iPhone 16 pro max couple of days back and got it yesterday. I was very excited as I was getting 512GB storage with an amazon backed brand to claim that renewed premium category is like a new. Now as I received my phone, it all looks very nice and I start begin the setup as well as checked everything from the physical perspective if nothing is damaged, I didn’t notice anything major till my son noticed that of the lens on the back side camera have a small chip cut that can easily be observed in day light as well as buy touching it with finger. Anyway I proceed with complete setup, and begin testing the phone, everything looks to be fine, batter at 95% which is good. But then I majorly stuck on side camera button, which was not functional. I did some research on YouTube and google if some setting or config needs to change, and I followed all the steps but nothing works and the conclusion that some sensor or side button is damaged and not functioning properly and this is big red flag if I am spending close to 1000$ on renewed premium product and expecting it to at least work 4 to 5 years. I also want to mention that, amazon send me the lighting cable, instead of usb C cable. Anyway next morning I called customer care to report my feedback and explain all the details, my concern was not that I can’t return it or can’t get the refund. But my biggest concern was of Trust in the branding for renewed premium category of product. Because if Vendor is claiming what they are selling then it supposed to be that way. Because if I have to buy a renewed premium category product I may think twice or more before taking that decision, and I think used premium category is a big market, so seller should focus on quality and maintaining the brand and not to sell the defective product to customer and create so much frustration. But the good thing is at least Renewed premium category is claiming to return and refund upto 365 days that customer support specialist also told me to not worry and return and try order another one, because its rare that such kind of issue come, but anyway I see 11% of customers report bad experience so this matters. Anyway I am retuning this phone today with less than 14 hours of receiving, I am not sure if I will order again, because of all such a big hassle in the whole experience of waiting the product to arrive, setup everything, and test out and its all about experience how much you want to invest in that effort. I am updating my review on May 22 regarding my experience with customer service while following up on my refund. It has now been two days since my return. On May 20, I spoke with an Amazon specialist about a defective product and requested a replacement. I was advised that the best option would be to initiate a return and return at Whole Foods and that I would receive a refund within a week, after which I could place a new order. However, today, when I contacted customer support to check the status of my refund, I had a very disappointing experience. The representative was rude, yelled her voice, and informed me that the refund would take up to 30 days. So be prepare, if you get a defective product then you stuck with your money and wont be able to buy another unless you get your money back. This is one of the worst experience i had as i cant use the product that i paid for, and the money also stuck for a month, that i cant use to buy another phone She also stated that the previous information I received about a 7-day refund was incorrect. She was not willing to listen to my concerns and ended the call abruptly. I have never encountered such poor customer service from Amazon before. This experience was frustrating and does not align with Amazon’s stated commitment to being customer-obsessed. Review Title: I ordered the iPhone 15 Pro Max refurbished and it arrived last night
Review Content: I ordered the iPhone 15 Pro Max refurbished and it arrived last night. After spending a good 3+ hours setting it up, I realized the lens for the main camera was broken. From the outside, you can’t see any issue. It wasn’t until I opened up the camera app that I actually saw it didn’t work. “Renewed Premium” carries a certain standard with it, and this certainly does not meet that in the slightest. On top of that, upon calling customer support, I was told that I would not be able to do anything unless I deactivated the phone and remove my Apple ID from it. Wouldn’t have been the end of the world if I needed to go back to my other phone for a bit, however, in order to set up this phone with the eSIM, deactivated my previous SIM card. Upon explaining all of that to customer support, I was told there was nothing they could do unless I deactivated this phone (leaving me without a phone until they received this and shipped me a new one) I was then told to call Apple to see what they can do, when honestly, this is their mistake. Either way, I called apple and it was going to be another set of hoops to jump through with scheduling appointments and all that. Plus since I didn’t have apple care, if they needed to repair the camera, I would still be without a phone. So even if Apple was able to help fix this, the issue of me not having a phone would still be there. Had I broken this camera myself - I would certainly except those terms given there’s not much else I could do. However, this was given to me in this condition and for Amazon to leave me with the responsibility of fixing their mistake due to carelessness in inspection and quality control is absurd. So whether I like it or not, I am now STUCK with the responsibility of cleaning this up since my account is connected to this phone now. What at one point could have been a great gift to myself has turned into the biggest hassle I’ve experienced buying/returning anything, probably ever. I’m going to give this one more shot as I’ve now ordered another iPhone from them to be delivered shortly, however, it’s also required me to spend another ~$1000 in having that iPhone sent prior to me getting my refund. This is absolutely ridiculous and unacceptable. Even if this next phone is perfect, I’m likely never going to order from the Amazon refurbished store again. I’ll either go straight to Apple refurbished, or brand new, for any of my future phone/laptop/device purchases. On top of all this hassle, I’ll certainly have to spend another few hours setting up my replacement phone once it arrives. All the time I’ve invested into this so far has NOT been even close worth the “nice discount” on a premium refurbished phone that should have arrived without issue to begin with. Amazon - take note. Change your policies. Making this the customer’s mess to clean up is not acceptable. I’ll plan to update this review if anything changes. But like I said, even if the next phone I ordered is perfect, I still give this a 1-star review for all the hassle and lack of responsibility the company took to resolve this. P.s. i’ll also add that I am a quite understanding and peaceful person. The person I spoke with from customer support was doing his absolute best to help me, but this was clearly a bigger issue than he had the power to solve. I requested to have this escalated to upper management and was told the same thing. Whoever is the one making decisions about what can and can’t be done needs to hear about this. Review Title: I purchased a refurbished Apple Watch 8 in excellent condition
Review Content: I purchased a refurbished Apple Watch 8 in excellent condition. The watch arrived with a scratch on the screen and a cheap knockoff wrist band that was hard to get fitted onto the watch. I was willing to let that go. I set up the watch. Charged it and took it off charger around 10pm and went to bed. I woke up the next morning at 8 am and put on the watch which had already went down to 88% battery life. By 4pm it was down to 42%. By this time I’m frustrated so I pull up the source code for the Apple Watch to find out how many battery cycles this watch has been though and the count was 409. As we all know batteries have finite lives. They can only handle being drained and charged so many times then they need to be replaced. An Apple Watch that has been drained and charged 409 times does not fit the bill of a refurbished item to me. Not by a long shot and Apple should be ashamed of themselves for letting this take place via an Amazon store with Apple in the name. Review Title: Perhaps the fact that the phone arrived a few days before the expected delivery date range was a goo
Review Content: Perhaps the fact that the phone arrived a few days before the expected delivery date range was a good omen. I specifically chose Amazon as the shipper/seller of the item. I felt that if there was any problems, having Amazon as the seller would entail less hassles with the resolution process. Fortunately, there were no major issues with iPhone. The front screen was scratch-free. There was some odd substance on the titanium sides (it seemed to be glue/adhesive residue). In general, the appearance was very good/excellent. The screen does not seem to retain much of the oil/fingerprint resistance feature. But, considering it was manufactured in 2024, this reduced aspect is to be expected. I think I'll eventually add a screen protector to deal with easy cleaning and additional protection of the screen. I ran apple diagnostics, and it passed on all the tests, indicating apple parts and functions. And, while the promise is for battery over 80% (I ordered the 'Renewed-Excellent'), it actually rated at 90%, with 591 cycles. I consider it a win. After transferring from my older iPhone, I only had to redo login/password for a few apps (financial and health apps, which makes sense that they're more secure). And, it was easy to transfer the esim to the 15Pro, too. Ordered a case today, which should arrive tomorrow. I'll be researching and ordering a screen protector this weekend. Considering an Apple Certified Refurb of same model and storage would be close to $1000, this was a very good value. My thinking was the battery state was probably the vulnerable aspect. So, even if I had to replace the battery after the 90 day warranty, the $100 cost was still be a financial win. (Hopefully, the battery lives as long as my iPhone XR did, haha). Anyway, I feel I made a wise choice getting this 'Renewed-Excellent' iPhone 15 Pro/512gb via Amazon (I did research other refurb venues, btw). Picking Amazon as shipper/seller was the safe, smart move too, imho. I would only be happier if the batty capacity was 100% and it came with a screen protector.

Review Title: It turns out that part of my biggest problem was how to discover why the phone did not work
Review Content: It turns out that part of my biggest problem was how to discover why the phone did not work. I spent hours on the phone with the carrier and texting with AI because I couldn't even get Apple to acknowledge my Apple account. Then after all my efforts I was locked out for 2 hours! It seems to me this is vital info for a new buyer like me, and it should be included by Amazon in their description. As it turned out the "board" connecting the eSim that issues the signal for cellular to work was defective. But no experts that I consulted realized that a simple test of the eSim is to try to read a Qr code, without a functioning eSim that will not be possible and certainly that is a simple test for verifying a several hundred dollar phone before giving it an Excellent premium rating in Amazon. For several other reasons too lengthy for this review, I now believe Amazon's rating of refurbished phones is BS. And their help is minuscule. Despite that, I ordered a replacement iPhone 15 pro through Amazon, again got suckered in on a non updated IOS, but so far, now that my Apple a/c is recognized, the phone appears to be truly excellent. Review Title: I’m writing this review with a few caveats I will get to
Review Content: I’m writing this review with a few caveats I will get to. First of all, the iPhone 13 mini is truly the best iPhone for people who want a phone that feels like a phone and not like they are carrying around a tablet. I have been using the iPhone 16 Pro since it came out and had no idea what I was missing in this older model until I was talking to a friend about his. He told me it was the best phone ever made and he would not get rid of his until he couldn’t get replacement parts or unless they made a new updated mini, which it sounds like they have no plans to do (a shame). I was telling him that I have been traveling with work and when I’m pulling a bag, I need to be able to work my phone well with one hand. The 16 Pro is not good for this. I don’t like cases, I don’t want to use a pop socket - I just want a pretty sleek unencumbered iPhone. So I was on a mission and it’s not an easy one when you’re picky about the condition and the phone can only be found in the used/renewed/refurbished channels. I had hesitations about buying from Amazon resale because of other items I’ve gotten from them that didn’t seem like they were inspected. I took a risk. I purchased the starlight 256gb from Amazon (not a marketplace seller). It was still a pretty penny considering the age of the mini, but the minis hold their value due to the cult following they have. I received it and it was absolutely perfect - didn’t look like it had ever been used, though the battery capacity was 85%…which was okay but nothing wonderful. In the meantime, I decided I would prefer the 512gb since I plan to keep this a long time, so I decided to order one, also from Amazon resale, since the 256 was in such pristine condition and I knew I had 90 days to decide regardless. The 512gb through Amazon was a crazy price…marked as excellent but over $550 with taxes (I had paid $330 for the 256gb). Cut to a day later, I see that a seller has the 512 starlight marked as excellent and it was $385. I reached out to them and asked them about the battery health and they were wonderful - got back to me really quickly and said 99%. So I thought, well, for $385 vs $550, I’ll cancel the Amazon order and order this one. Unfortunately it was too late to cancel the Amazon one - it had already shipped - so my intention was to just send it straight back as soon as it was delivered. The one from the actual cellphone reseller got here quickly and for the price, was represented well - it did have 2 corners with blemishes that look like they’re from a drop, but they weren’t terrible but having seen the pristine 256gb version from Amazon, I was being overly picky. The battery was 100%, as they had told me, which was great, but what I noticed was the screen had been replaced. I’m okay with screen replacements - any phone from 2021 has probably had one, as well as any battery that shows 100% on a phone from 2021 is a replaced battery. These are not bad things. What I do know from having a screen replaced years ago through one of the shops that uses an aftermarket part is the screens are not as flat as apple’s genuine screen if you get a replacement from them. It almost has waves in it, especially along the edges. They look fine if you aren’t picky to the degree I am, or looking at the phone from an angle, but I’ve found they are not always reliable screens with regard to the responsiveness. As soon as I saw this, I packed it back up and set up a return through the seller and took it straight to the UPS store. Cut to my next Amazon delivery, the 512gb model that I had been unable to cancel arrives. Since the one from the reseller didn’t work out for me, I said, well, let’s check this out because if it’s perfect, then I guess it’s worth the $550 spent. Open it up and WOW! The body of it is just like the 256 I had gotten. Pristine - not a drop ding or scratch in sight. Perfect screen…remarkable…but I wanted to check the battery. When I got it up and running, I checked the battery capacity and it was at 100%. Under the battery details it even lists it as a Genuine battery, so it was “renewed” with Apple OEM. I could not be more thrilled even though it cost way more than a phone from 2021 should. But I’m keeping it for the long haul so it’s worth it knowing I don’t have a battery replacement in the near future. I’ve got the 90 days to see how it functions but I feel pretty good about this one. TL;DR - the iPhone mini is a phone you will be addicted to after use. It’s so functional and what a “phone” should be. Do not hesitate to order one shipped from and sold by Amazon.com. I can confirm they have fantastic quality control when it comes to their phones. If you pick a reseller other than Amazon, just make sure you get the 90 day return and that there aren’t “restocking” fees buried in their policies.
