Review Title: But I was still wanting to check out the APM
Review Content: But I was still wanting to check out the APM. Price is a bit crazy but I decided to order renewed and insurance again JIC. Now that I’ve had them about 4 days (I’m sorry Sony) I’m in love all over again! They sound absolutely amazing. The spatial audio really works well (Sony has a similar feature but it’s only supported by certain streaming services not including Apple). The soundstage opens up to something really fantastic sounding. Now reasons not to buy and why others may have returned theirs (thank you whoever sent mine back). THIS IS VERY IMPORTANT, if you don’t have an Apple device to connect to any only android or a PC, DO NOT BUY THESE! You will be seriously disappointed. You won’t be able to EQ them at all unless you use a 3rd party app or your device has EQ built in. I was very disappointed when I first connected and listened so some music, they were not good. Flat sounding with hardly any bass or treble! Like WTF, this can’t be right. Googled some information and instructions on how to properly set up Apple AirPods and the Max. You have to go into settings and go through a hearing test procedure that tunes the EQ specifically to your own ears. Listening to tones very similar to going to an audiologist. The results after that were WOW, what a difference nice broad response, solid bass, not quite as good as Sony who allows EQ from their app and have a special bass enhancement system, but solid and good definition. The soundstage opened up also with any stereo material. Then when you turn on spatial audio it’s WOW again, Apple did a really good job of processing the music and not messing it up. It goes from just headphones to room phones, the sound is around you! You can opt to let the headphones track your head movements or not. If you turn the music stays where it was, but after a few seconds of you don’t turn back they recenter you again. I really held off a long time as the price on these is really extreme compared to what the competition are selling as “equivalents”. The build quality on the Apple really separates them from the pack. With steel headband and aluminum components they should be very durable. Sony and Bose are, well… just plastic. As to lack of folding ability, I really don’t care, 99% of my listening is at home. I use earbuds if I’m outside or working out. The holder is… interesting. Different than what I’m used to but seems to work just fine around the house. Now I’ll try to wrap up with a comment about other reviews complaining about no power cords or chargers…I DON’T CARE!! I HAVE TOO MANY NOW!! lol, really if you have Apple products around you’re going to have a lightning cable and charger somewhere! Then, noise cancellation reaction…can I say WOW again? Really, my Sony are good but these are significantly better. Things I can’t hear or barely heard around the house with Sony that I don’t hear with APM. The TV, my wife, fans, well almost anything! Sony works well but their around ear system still rest on my Dumbo sized ears! lol. The Apple are really around the ear with a little room! This helps with noise control and comfort. And finally, comfort…the Sony are very comfortable but the plastic cups get hot and sweaty after a few minutes. The Apple are much better in that respect. My only criticism I guess would be comfort though. The clamping force on my head is significant by I’m getting used to it. I know my ears are large enough but I don’t think my head is oversized! Not ridiculous but definitely more than Sony, but the do stay in place well. If you have an iPhone or Apple devices to use these with and take the time to set them up properly you’ll be very happy. 3 months later and the refurbished Max went bad. Could not stay connected with Bluetooth so fortunately within the Amazon return window. Returned, credited and also reimbursed for the Asurion warranty. So, this was bad but I liked them a lot so I went out and picked up a brand new Pro Max. Not using the spatial sound much but the noise cancellation on the Max is awesome! Having foundation repairs done and staying in an upstairs bedroom with these on and I can hardly hear the industrial tools in use. These are far and away the best NC headphones I’ve owned. Still highly recommended but didn’t want to roll the dice on refurbished this time around! Review Content: I was really excited to buy these because as a college student I am always balling on a budget, but honestly these were not refurbished very nicely. Kind of gross since that was my first unboxing experience, but I guess you get what you pay for. Also, there were several wear and tear marks on the side of the ears, and the top headband portion has some build up from the previous owner. The fit of the headphones were a bit big as the headband piece is not as stiff due to previous owner I believe. When I did initially connect them to my iPhone, it did show the previous owner’s name, and I was a bit worried because I do not know whether or not they were able to find these headphones on “ Find my iPhone” and have my location until I put under my account. So that could be a security and privacy issue for some. Overall, the quality was not up to par with other Apple products I have bought over the years, but again that is due to these being reused/refurbished. I am glad I was able to review this type of product, but I will definitely be returning and will most likely buy a new pair of AirPod Max’s at the Apple Store when I can save up another $100 or so. Product Title: Amazon.com: Apple Watch Series 8 [GPS, 41mm] - Midnight Aluminum Case with Midnight Sport Band, S/M (Renewed) : Clothing, Shoes & Jewelry
Review Title: Compré este reloj en condición "Excelente", pero de excelente no tiene casi nada
Review Content: Compré este reloj en condición "Excelente", pero de excelente no tiene casi nada. Debería estar catalogado como "Bueno" o "Regular", porque siendo sinceros, sí tiene rayones bastante perceptibles que incluso se sienten al pasar el dedo. Entiendo que es un producto reacondicionado; el problema es que lo venden como “Excelente” y no debería ser así. En cuanto a funcionalidad, llegó impecable. Todo funciona sin problema y la salud de la batería llegó al 87%. En las fotos que agregué se puede ver que desconecté el reloj a las 11:40 a.m. y para las 11:41 p.m. aún tenía el 48% de batería restante. Esto, claramente, con la pantalla siempre activa (AOD) apagada. Con el AOD encendido noté que la batería sí se descarga muchísimo más rápido; le calculo que en vez del 48%, a esa misma hora me habría quedado un 18% o incluso menos. Algo que no me gustó para nada es el cargador genérico incluido. Supuestamente es de la marca Steren, aunque lo dudo, porque la verdad se siente de muy mala calidad (como un cargador muy barato de los que ves en el tianguis). Tardó más de una hora solo en lograr encender el reloj, ya que el equipo llegó con la batería completamente muerta. Llegué incluso a pensar que el reloj estaba defectuoso porque no encendía, pero después de un largo rato por fin lo hizo. Este cargador es de muy baja potencia y provoca que el reloj se caliente bastante; la carga de 0 a 100% tomó más de 2 horas. Si consigues el cable de carga rápida original de Apple, este modelo se carga por completo en unos 45 minutos, ya que el Series 8 sí soporta esta tecnología (me parece que está disponible del Series 7 en adelante). Conclusión: Sí recomiendo la compra (lo compré por un precio de $3,530.27 MXN), pero hagan la inversión de adquirir el cable original (cuesta $649 MXN) para que puedan aprovechar la carga rápida y no tengan que estar esperando más de 2 horas. Por mi parte, aún estoy indeciso sobre si regresarlo o quedármelo, únicamente por los rayones, ya que se perciben demasiado, si no hubiese sido una excelente compra. Bueno, esa fue mi experiencia espero y les sirva.       [Read more Read less](javascript:void(0))

Review Title: I recently upgraded from a 45mm Series 9 to the new Black Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3
Review Content: I recently upgraded from a 45mm Series 9 to the new Black Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3. Instead of paying the $799 retail price, I decided to take a gamble on an "Open Box" unit from iPower Resale for $609. The gamble paid off flawlessly. The watch arrived in its original box, and the included charger and watch band were still sealed in Apple's factory packaging. Checking the settings, the battery health is sitting dead-on at exactly 100%, and the device still has an active Apple Limited Warranty until January 2027. For all intents and purposes, I saved $190 on a brand-new watch. Size & The Screen Upgrade A lot of the online consensus claims that jumping from a 45mm Series watch to the 49mm Ultra isn't that noticeable of a screen difference. I completely disagree. The switch to the flat sapphire crystal glass changes the entire experience. Because it doesn't curve off at the edges like the Series 9, the usable screen real estate feels massive. Add in the 3,000 nits of brightness, and the display is incredibly crisp and visible from across the room. Comfort & Battery Life Is the watch huge? Yes, it is objectively a large, thick piece of titanium. But despite the visual bulk, it is surprisingly balanced on the wrist. It doesn't feel like you are wearing a brick, and it is comfortable enough that I sleep in it every single night without any discomfort. The biggest quality-of-life improvement coming from the Series 9 is the battery. Being able to track sleep all night and wake up without needing a "panic charge" to get through the workday is a game-changer. The Verdict: 5/5 Stars If you are on the fence about the 49mm size, it is worth the jump. The Black Titanium finish looks incredibly premium, the flat screen is a massive functional upgrade, and if you can find a verifiable mint open-box deal with the factory warranty intact, it is an absolute steal. Review Title: ##### Excelente pantalla y carga rápida, ¡vale totalmente la pena!
Review Content: ##### Excelente pantalla y carga rápida, ¡vale totalmente la pena! He estado usando el Apple Watch Series 7 y la experiencia ha sido fantástica. Lo que más destaca a primera vista es la pantalla: los marcos son superdelgados y se aprovecha muchísimo mejor el espacio en comparación con modelos anteriores. La función de pantalla siempre activa (Always-On) ahora es más brillante en interiores, por lo que se puede ver la hora de un vistazo sin tener que levantar exageradamente el brazo. Otro gran acierto es la carga rápida. Aunque la batería sigue durando un día completo (lo normal en estos relojes), se carga muchísimo más rápido con su cable USB-C incluido; en unos 45 minutos recuperas casi toda la energía. En cuanto a salud, las mediciones de oxígeno en sangre, el sensor de ritmo cardíaco y los electrocardiogramas funcionan de maravilla. Es un reloj resistente (tiene mejor protección contra el polvo y golpes en el cristal) y muy fluido. Si buscas un smartwatch completo, deportivo y elegante, es una compra 10/10. Review Title: Since I already had an Apple Watch charger, I’ve been using that one just for peace of mind—call it
Review Content: Since I already had an Apple Watch charger, I’ve been using that one just for peace of mind—call it my little OCD moment! 😊 Before purchasing, I read some reviews where people mentioned issues like the watch not turning on, poor battery life, or updates taking forever. I did notice it took a while to charge initially, but after that, everything went smoothly. The update and syncing process with my iPhone did take a bit of time, but that’s normal for Apple Watches (especially refurbished ones). For anyone wondering, remember that Apple Watches are not like iPhones—they have different battery performance expectations. Speaking of the battery, mine arrived with 84% battery capacity. While that might seem a bit low, it’s within the typical range for a refurbished Apple Watch. For anyone who wants a new battery, Apple offers a replacement service for a fee. If you have AppleCare+ and your battery capacity drops below 80%, the replacement might even be free. After using the watch for two days, I’m really impressed. It’s fast, responsive, and everything works perfectly. I’m a big Apple fan, so I had high hopes, and this purchase met my expectations. When you buy something refurbished on Amazon, it’s always a bit of a gamble—but this time, it paid off! Highly recommend this if you’re looking for a reliable refurbished Apple Watch. It's obvious to me that this phone was ready to go out when they sold it. I know buying a refurbished phone is a risk but I think we should be able to assume that any parts that could go bad have been replaced so although it is a used phone, the parts that can go bad have been replaced. This company obviously does not do that and I will never use them again. Lesson learned. I do not recommend this company at all but if you do buy from them and your phone starts acting strange, contact them immediately and demand to return the phone. If you wait, you will lose your chance and will have wasted your money. Review Title: For my ear type (medium sized, don’t stick out from my head over an inch rounded out, and a bit narr
Review Content: For my ear type (medium sized, don’t stick out from my head over an inch rounded out, and a bit narrow) I do not experience any discomfort. Though at first I did feel a small strain.. They seem to have adjusted slightly to my ear. Despite the fact that Apple now owns Beats... unlike AirPods with their much more efficient magnet method of placing the headphones into the case: you may find a 3 second delay in putting the PowerBeats Pro back in the charging case to begin with... I guess you can say it gives your mind a slight workout haha. But you’ll get used to it. 3 seconds is not too long. I love the button configuration - makes it very easy to change whatever I am listening to, pause, play, and toggle the volume. I also love the look and aesthetic overall. I personally purchased the ivory color and I am very happy with my choice. Some may not have a liking to the size of the charging case which is honestly pretty bulky and about the size of my palm. Though as mentioned in my recommendation, If you get a case you can have the option of having a small carabiner hook which may help some in carrying it around. No scratches, blemishes, or issues at all. A great way to save an extra few coins if you’d like. Along with the fact that naturally... the normal price for the Power Beat Pros are slightly lower than the commonly compared Airpod Pros. As for any device (phone, tablet, laptop) I would recommend getting a case for them. My last AirPods always found a way to get scratched in my bag or from falling. I don’t believe they have a way of tracking hilt into them. If there is I’m unaware of it. Product Title: Amazon.com: Apple Powerbeats Pro Totally Wireless & High-Performance Bluetooth Earphone, Ivory (Renewed) : Electronics
Review Content: 1. Not sure if it's just an updated design or if the earpieces were replaced with inferior materials, but these felt thinner and less sturdy than my original pair. The others hugged my ears perfectly after molding the earpiece into place, but these never felt as secure or comfortable. 2. The sensor that detects whether or not it's in your ear does not work well and results in my phone continuously playing through them when I take them out of my ear, and also picking up calls through the buds when I'm not using them, even though they're not supposed to do that when they're out of your ear! 3. After three months, the bluetooth speakerphone, which I loved for making work calls, has completely stopped working. 4. The battery life started out bad and has only gotten worse in the last three months. My old pair would last basically from when I got up in the morning until the end of the work day, so 8-10hrs. These crap out in the middle of the workday, and the battery time gets shorter and shorter. Occasionally, if I'm wearing them but not playing anything through them or talking on the phone, they will just disconnect randomly. I hope I can get some new ones that are the same quality as my old set. But it may just be another unfortunate by-product of the tech industry pushing out more poor quality products for suckers like me to buy. Review Content: Unlike the Apple Studio headphones which are great…but have too many moving parts that make them susceptible to inevitable damage/malfunction. I don’t like product that are to tech heavy…These Powerbeats Pro are my third pair. The first pair I broke because I accidental stepped on them . The second pair are still going 3 years strong! If any headphones last more than a year in a half…you got your moneys worth. These head phones work with all my Apple products and really help my work flow. I take all calls hands free and wear these all day. At first the headphones annoyed my ears… a long time ago. Now, my ears feel weird not having them in my ears. Noise cancellation is 7 out of 10. Just experiment with the different ear pieces. No head phones will truly block out sound totally. Review Content: The watch seems okay on the outside (no visible issues) and it arrived faster than expected, but I cannot pair it with the iphone so I cannot test to make sure it works properly. When I purchased this watch, I never saw any mention of on the product page that the watch must be paired with an iphone 11 or later. It's my mistake for not doing more research before purchasing this watch, but the Rufus AI chat on Amazon's website says the Apple Watch series 11 will pair with iphone xs max. This appears to be incorrect. When the watch did not pair, I wasted a lot of time trying to watch videos on the Amazon website to troubleshoot this, but finally gave up and did an outside search where I learned series 11 watches won't work with iphone xs max. So.... for anyone with an older phone like the xs max, be warned that this watch will not work! I bought this for my elderly mom to track some health concerns. I have a series 9 watch and decided if she didn't like the watch, I'd just take her series 11 watch and sell the series 9. We both have iphone xs max phones so now I need to either return this watch or buy an upgraded phone. I'm so frustrated and disappointed that I couldn't just pair this watch with her phone. I will update this review if I end up keeping it and pairing with a newer phone, but for now, I want to warn others in a similar situation with older iphones. Review Title: Well clearly, I was not satisfied to receive a phone with a significantly degraded battery
Review Content: Well clearly, I was not satisfied to receive a phone with a significantly degraded battery. So, I called Amazon Customer service to explain the problem and request a replacement. I did this on the same day I received the phone. The representative was helpful and told me he would send out a replacement immediately, and even upgrade the shipment method for no extra charge. He also told me, both in conversation and in writing to “use the box the replacement comes in to return the original.” That way, I would not be without a phone while waiting for the replacement to arrive. The day the replacement was scheduled to arrive and but had not, I called Amazon customer service back to inquire about the status. Much to my surprise, I was told the replacement phone order had been cancelled by the third-party seller because the original had not been returned. This irritated me for two reasons: (1) I had never been notified the replacement order had been cancelled—apparently, had I not called Amazon was simply going to drop the issue, and (2) I was specifically told by Amazon Customer Service that I did not need to return the original until the replacement was received. I told the agent this was unacceptable and wanted the replacement sent to me, as had been previously arranged. When it became clear that she would not be able to help me, I asked to speak with her manager. After providing her with my phone number, she said her manager would call me back. That phone call never happened. The following day I called Amazon customer service again, now the third time trying to get this issue resolved. I explained the steps I had taken thus far and was put on hold so the representative could verify if my replacement order “was legit.” When I asked what “legit” meant, she said she needed to verify if this was unusual activity on the account because it was a phone purchase. I told her that of course it was legit, as I had email documentation regarding the entire process! After being on hold, she came back and told me the replacement phone would be delivered within 5 days. She also said she would personally call me on that day to verify that it was received. I asked her to clarify that I would receive the replacement first, prior to sending the original back, according to the instructions I had previously received via email. She looked up that email and saw it said: “Please feel free to use the box the replacement comes in to return the original…” After reading that she placed me on hold again. After a minute or so, she came back on the line and asked if she could place me on hold for an additional few minutes. I asked why. She said she was trying to find out what went wrong with the first replacement order. When she came back on the line, she told me “to be on the safe side” I should return the original defective phone first to receive a replacement. I reiterated that this was unacceptable and that I had held up my end of the bargain and done exactly as Amazon had told me to do. I wanted the replacement sent first before I returned the defective phone. She said the email I received was in error and the person who sent it made a mistake—the defective phone would need to be returned before the replacement is shipped out. I told her that while I understand that people make mistakes, I did not think I should be penalized (i.e., be without a phone for at least 5 days) for a mistake that Amazon made. She apologized for the mistake but made it clear that I would not receive a replacement until the original was returned. I informed her I would be writing a negative review. To summarize: I was sent a defective phone, was given incorrect information about how to replace it, had the replacement order silently cancelled without being notified, and Amazon refused to follow through on the terms of their agreement. One star.       [Read more Read less](javascript:void(0))

Review Title: ##### Il mio primo rigenerato Amazon, vi racconto tutto
Review Content: ##### Il mio primo rigenerato Amazon, vi racconto tutto. Veniamo all'oggetto della recensione: l'iphone. Una volta tirato fuori dall'orrenda bustina di plastica che lo conteneva, l'ho accuratamente ispezionato rilevando un piccolo segno marcato (circa 1x1 mm) nella parte superiore sinistra dello schermo, dove il display si unisce al notch. A questo si aggiunge un piccolissimo segno (non so come altro definirlo) tra lo schermo e la scocca, nella parte inferiore sinistra. Entrambi i segni sono pressocchè invisibili ad una prima occhiata, occorre esaminare con cura il telefono per rilevarli. Il resto (scocca, schermo, bordi, ecc) è come nuovo. Amazon Renewed dichiara che il telefono "non presenta imperfezioni estetiche visibili tenendo il prodotto a una distanza di 30 centimetri", e direi che la promessa è stata assolutamente mantenuta, ben oltre le aspettative. Esaurita la parte estetica, accendiamo il telefono: l'avvio è immediato, i colori, la luminosità e la presenza dell'opzione True Tone mi fanno pensare che il display è originale Apple, difatti la mancanza del True Tone è solitamente indice di un display non originale o quantomeno più economico di quelli normalmente usati da Apple. Anche il codice IMEI riportato fisicamente sul "cassettino" della Sim corrisponde a quello indicato nelle informazioni del telefono, cosa che mi permette di ipotizzare che il telefono non è il risultato di un assemblaggio di più pezzi provenienti da altri telefoni. La configurazione è avvenuta senza difficoltà e dopo un accurato test di tutta la sensoristica e delle varie parti (Face Id, prossimità, luminosità, touch & 3d touch, giroscopi, tasto muto, volume, power, flash, ricarica wireless, altoparlanti, ecc ecc) non ho rilevato malfunzionamenti o problemi di alcun genere. Il telefono è arrivato con iOs 14.8, versione che se non ricordo male è stata rilasciata intorno a settembre 2021. Analizzando il seriale è possibile determinare l'anno di produzione: il mio nuovo amico risulta essere stato assemblato a Chengdu intorno alla seconda metà di settembre 2018. Facendo due conti, il telefono è rimasto "in giro" da settembre 2018 a settembre 2021, poi non è stato più aggiornato e quindi presumo utilizzato. La batteria presenta una capacità massima dell'80%, in linea a quanto indicato nelle condizioni del prodotto su Amazon. Di sicuro è stato usato non poco, ma il fatto che possa leggere quel valore è un altro ottimo indicatore, significa infatti che la batteria è ancora quella originale, altresì avrei un avviso di "batteria non originale". La scocca posteriore è priva del marchio CE, che di solito identifica i telefoni nati per il mercato Europeo. Ma niente paura, in questo caso significa solo che questo telefono era originariamente destinato al mercato americano o asiatico. Tuttavia, poichè la fotocamera non produce il rumore dello scatto quando è in modalità silenziosa, propendo per il mercato USA. In quello cinese infatti, se non è cambiato qualcosa, i telefoni devono per legge emettere sempre il rumore dello scatto fotografico, così da impedire scatti "rubati". Dura lex, sed lex! Infine faccio una delle ultime ma più importanti prove, vado sul sito Apple e tramite codice seriale verifico la garanzia: e qui ecco la sorpresa (bella)! Non solo il prodotto è regolare, non ci sono allarmi e il seriale è corretto, ma risulto addirittura coperto dall'AppleCare+ fino al 17 di questo mese, mica male :-). Concludo (finalmente, direte voi!): in questo momento sono estremamente contento del mio acquisto, l'iphone è praticamente nuovo e funziona bene. Direi un bel 5 stelle tanto ad Amazon quanto al venditore NEGOZIOREALE, che hanno superato le mie aspettative. Se state leggendo questa recensione, e non importa quando, significa che il telefono sta continuando a funzionare bene. Al primo accenno di problema state sicuri che verrò subito qui ad aggiornare la mia recensione. Review Title: ##### Renewed-Excellent Arrived in Perfect Condition with 100% Battery Health/Capacity
Review Content: ##### Renewed-Excellent Arrived in Perfect Condition with 100% Battery Health/Capacity I ordered an Amazon Renewed refurbished iPhone Air 256GB (unlocked) from Amazon in March 2026. Apple initially released the iPhone Air in September 2025, so any given unit couldn't be more than 6 months old. For that reason I took a chance by ordering a unit in "Excellent" condition, rather than "Premium" condition, for $80 less. (As of a week later, Excellent units are even cheaper compared to Premium units.) The phone arrived in perfect condition. Not a scratch on it. And even better: its battery health/capacity is 100%, which is far better than Amazon promises for "Excellent" condition units ("Battery: >80% of original battery life"). The OS reports that the phone was first used in October 2025, and only went through 7 battery cycles. So, it seems like it's a unit that someone bought new and returned almost immediately. In my experience, these "Amazon Renewed" phones come from a variety of vendors. My iPhone Air came from "T4C We Track Serial Numbers." --Yes, weird name (maybe a warning to buyers who might try to swap phones by returning a different phone?). But they provided a perfect product. As to the iPhone Air, I settled on it after trying a few different phones, including the iPhone 15 Pro Max, the iPhone 16e, the iPhone 16 Plus, and the iPhone 17e. I had always thought of the iPhone Air as a terrible compromise: larger (but not largest) screen, lesser camera, and far less battery capacity. However, I wanted a slightly larger screen than the standard 6.1 inches, and I don't really prioritize my phone's camera. Plus, I also don't use my phone so much, every day, that I need huge battery capacity. So, after finding that the iPhone 16e's and iPhone 17e's screens were too small, and that the iPhone 15 Pro Max was just way too bulky and heavy, I gave the iPhone Air a chance. I found that the iPhone Air's larger screen (6.5 inches), lighter weight, and dramatically thinner frame make it really pleasant to handle for light, everyday use. And the single-lens camera and lower battery capacity are sufficient for my needs. You can put a nice case on it, and it still feels way thinner than any other iPhone. The only difference between mine and new was that mine had been charged to 100%, 15 times. What's that, two weeks of use before someone returned it? The condition was flawless and I have a one year warranty provided with the purchase. The majority of happy, giddy, ecstatic iPhone Air owners are not content creators and think the iPhone Air is awesome. YouTube reviewers depend on their mobile phones to produce video and photos and are not the best judge of the iPhone Air that isn't the very best at producing media. I am not a content creator, but was a professional photographer many years and I am extremely happy with the photos the Air produces. I am retired now and no longer need to shoot in RAW for extensive editing. My previous iPhone 15 Pro took very good photos, but I had to spend time editing in order to back off of the extreme automated processing of the phone's software algorithims. I shot photos at a birthday party at night, outdoors, only lit by string lighting and found the photos to be very natural, not overly processed, well exposed with an absence of grain, even cropping in 3-5x. Yes, the Air does not play with stereo speakers. But it is very loud and clear and basically when not using my airpods or using airplay to a bluetooth speaker, it is just fine, no issues. Think about it, how often do you depend on your phone to play loud stereo music? You can always stream to a bluetooth stereo speaker or home stereo or wear your airpods. I do a lot of streaming music and podcasts during the day 2-4 hrs worth, receive/answer emails, a lot of texts and take photos and send via iMessage and I'm finding my battery still has 30-50% battery left at 6pm. I don't typically put my phone on a charger during the day and by 6pm I'm ready to eat dinner and relax in the evening so sitting my phone on a magsafe charger stand is an easy way to finish out the day. I did buy Anker's Magsafe power bank that matches the iPhone Air (white) but I've not used it much, more out of convenience because I had it rather than as a necessity. So far I am pleased with the battery performance. It's 3pm right now and the phone has been off of the charger since 7am and there is still 84% battery, without much use though, but that is impressive. I am enjoying the thinness of the Air, easy to hold, slides into my pocket and the screen is brilliant and easy to see, even in sunshine. I am coming from an iPhone 15 Pro, so the screen is much bigger than I'm used to but it's nice. The processor is very fast and 120Hz pro-motion is extremely nice. What are the downsides? Without a case, it is very slippery and for that reason alone I ended up buying an extremely thin Aramid case from Pitaka to increase the grip. I wasn't worried too much about scratches as I am very careful with my phones, but now I admit, I can relax alittle and I believe the case actually improved the look of the AIR rather than detracted. Review Title: I never once jonesed for an Apple Watch — mainly because they are huge (and pricey for me) — so I al
Review Content: I never once jonesed for an Apple Watch — mainly because they are huge (and pricey for me) — so I always settled for the smallest and least expensive Fitbits instead (I’ve had 3 different models). They were sufficient, but the last one was a big disappointment. So I took another look at the smallest and lowest priced Apple Watch. I found the latest model 40mm SE 3, used but in excellent condition, for $180 on Amazon. I would’ve never guessed it was used at all if it wasn’t for the scotch tape on the packaging — and it appears to even still be under the original warranty. Awesome! The differences between this and the higher-end models were things I didn’t need (like slightly faster battery charging time, more time between charges, ECG app, SpO2 sensor, water resistance, etc.). PROS: I like the wide array of watch faces and customization options for most of them. My personal favorite is the one that includes the option for a 5-hour weather forecast. If you install other faces, you can easily switch between them directly from the watch. I have one with a second hand ready to swipe to for times when I want or need that. One of my favorite features is the ability to set and name alarms by speaking it: “set alarm at 1pm to start getting ready for appointment.” And likewise set and name countdown timers: “set timer to check laundry in 1 hour.” I use this often and it works better than it does on even the iPhone or iPad. The one feature that justified the price for me was the crash/fall detection and emergency SOS. I will be 70 next year and although I’ve never had an issue that required any of this so far (knock on wood), you never know. CONS: I was originally not thrilled that I’d have to charge it every day instead of having it last several days (like my Fitbits did). Product Title: Amazon.com: Apple Watch Series 6 (GPS, 44mm) - Silver Aluminum Case with White Sport Band (Renewed) : Clothing, Shoes & Jewelry
Review Title: Returned the watch
Review Content: Returned the watch. The microphone intermittently functioned, the scratches were bothering me, and new watches are only $100 more than this beat up thing. Yes, $100 isn’t cheap, but overall it was worth the extra cost. My new Apple Watch 7 has a larger screen and no signs of use. It’s worth the upgrade, especially when Amazon describes the refurbished watch “like new” when that is clearly not the case. Calls from the refurbished watch only worked half the time, and the speaker sounded muffled. Just pony up for a new watch, which are discounted right now for an apple 7, and be happy. Hope this updates helps you decide. Ok, the watch costs less than new, but that’s about where the good stuff ends. It did include a usb charger (Samsung brand! 😟) generic charging cable, off-brand white strap, and poorly packaged in a generic white box. Literally nothing was done to “recondition” the watch. First thing I had to do was clean off the former user’s grime that coated the watch back (yuck!). This took some soap, water, and a toothbrush to clean out the little crevices. Screen and case came with minor scratches overall, with one more annoying, more pronounced screen scratch that really bugs me. Battery was completely depleted, which is not good for lithium batteries. C’mon, for the money you could at least clean and charge the thing! It’s not in terrible shape, but very clearly used. It certainly was not refurbished in any way that I can tell. Imagine buying the watch from your mom after she wore it for a year and you get the idea about my watch’s condition. Not abused, but certainly used. I’m torn. This was not a great purchase, and I’m left wondering if its worth the $150 less than new price. Hard to say. Just don’t believe the product description claiming “appears new” because that is far from the truth. Set your expectations accordingly if you purchase from the “Camera Guyz”. They just take the watch, toss it in a nondescript box with whatever knockoff bits they have laying around, and mail it to you. Look, you’re still paying a lot of money, so there’s no reason not to expect a quality product. Amazon says I have a 90 day warranty, so there’s time (accidental pun) to evaluate it further. Yes it works. Yes, I will eventually add more wear and tear to the watch when wearing. Yes, the “appears new” description is complete fiction. Overall value is debatable. One star for inaccurate condition description and an annoying screen scratch. Review Title: These are fantastic! I’m so glad I bought them
Review Content: These are fantastic! I’m so glad I bought them. The Renewed Premiere 2nd Gen Apple AirPods pro are definitely worth the price— the sound in incredible, especially when listening to tracks with Dolby Atmos activated in Apple Music. Review Title: This is a review both for the AirPods Pro (2nd gen), but also for the Amazon Renewal program
Review Content: This is a review both for the AirPods Pro (2nd gen), but also for the Amazon Renewal program. I'm not bought into the Apple ecosystem and have no plans to do so, but I won a pair of these at a work event, and they changed my life. Seriously I'm so much more productive because I don't have to listen to the loud project manager sitting next to me on calls all day - that's how good the active noise canceling is. If that's what you're looking for in a pair of earbuds, I've tried and failed to find anything comparable that didn't sacrifice on some other criterion (battery life first and foremost). But here's the deal about the Amazon Renewal thing... I got another pair of honest-to-goodness AirPod Pros in perfect condition with all the accessories at a sizeable discount (though as I write this the same product sold by Apple is discounted down to $190, which is what I paid for this pair :) ). While Amazon isn't my favorite company, and I've had both good and bad experiences with it, I'm happy to help reduce their (and by extension, other companies') environmental footprint by buying a perfectly good product at a cheaper rate just because somebody else's expectations of it weren't met. The packaging of all the accessories was great, the product itself was, as mentioned, indistinguishable from a brand-new set, and I was incredibly happy with them. Now, after finding out that my wife is one of the unfortunate people who are susceptible to vertigo from using noise-canceling headphones, it didn't make sense for us to have 2 pairs, so I decided to return the set I bought Renewed. After a little bit of uncertainty around the return process (the UPS driver will bring a printed label for my otherwise unlabeled package? And I wasn't actually present when he picked it up, so I had to take it on faith that they did, in fact, do that rather than just swiping the box...), I'm getting my full refund, and presumably, somebody else will become the new owner of this nearly-pristine product which reduced Apple's demand for more product to be created by 2 units (so far). In my mind, this program is a win for everyone (possible exceptions of Apple, and employees of Amazon) and the environment. I know what goes into electronics manufacturing (and what comes out other than products), so I'm really glad to see this happening. Super glad Amazon does all this. Review Content: The Apple Watch Ultra 2 is a rugged and high-performance smartwatch designed for outdoor adventurers, athletes, and tech enthusiasts. It features a bright and durable 49mm titanium case, a customizable Action button for quick access to key functions, and an always-on Retina display with up to 3,000 nits of brightness for excellent visibility in any condition. The watch offers an impressive battery life of up to 36 hours (or 72 hours in Low Power Mode), making it a reliable companion for extended adventures. Its enhanced GPS precision, water resistance up to 100 meters, and dive capabilities up to 40 meters cater to those who push their limits. With comprehensive health and fitness tracking, including advanced running metrics, heart rate monitoring, sleep analysis, and blood oxygen measurement, the Apple Watch Ultra 2 supports a wide range of activities. Its integration with watchOS 10 brings new widgets, improved cycling features, and an upgraded Compass app with topographic maps. Built for extreme conditions and everyday wear alike, the Apple Watch Ultra 2 is a powerful tool for those who demand durability, innovation, and cutting-edge technology in a smartwatch.

Review Title: It has the worst battery life of any iPhone I've ever owned, and I have owned ONLY iPhones since the
Review Content: It has the worst battery life of any iPhone I've ever owned, and I have owned ONLY iPhones since the first version was released 17 years ago. This is the second iPhone 14 that I've bought from the renewed store . The first one I bought on December 4th, 2023, and I could not have been happier with the phone. It arrived in brand new condition, and performed flawlessly. On the recommendation of a friend, I checked the battery health and charging after having it for MONTHS and it was at 100%! I was thrilled! Unfortunately, on July 30 of this year I dropped it, and it was beyond repair. I immediately went back to the Amazon renewed store and purchased another iPhone 14 because my experience with the first one was so fantastic. It arrived in new looking condition, exactly like the one I bought in December 2023. It was not scratched or anything really noticeable, it just seemed to be "worn" a little bit, but I fully understood that it was a renewed phone, and any cosmetic issues were not that important to me, including the color, which, when my iPhone is in its case, you cannot tell what color it is anyway. Unfortunately, I DID NOT look at the battery health and charging when I first got the phone 38 days ago, but I did look at it about two weeks ago, and it said 93%. I thought, ok, it's a renewed phone, it's not going to have 100% battery life. Well, I just looked at it today and it's now at 90% battery health and charging. I have it completely set up for optimized battery life. I have lost emails and messages that I was in the middle of composing, and the phone just dies. I've been in the middle of important phone calls when the phone dies, simply because I had just fully charged it a few hours before that, and thought I would be fine for hours to come. I just had a total shoulder replacement surgery a week ago, and I was on the phone with my doctors office yesterday about my first post-op appointment, and my phone died in the middle of it. I thought I had HOURS left before the phone would die. Then I had to plug it in, and wait for it to come back alive, so I could call my doctor back and hopefully not wait a half hour after losing my place in line. On top of that is also has issues with the touchscreen being glitchy, and sometimes I have to tap on things several times to get them to work. As I said, I have been an iPhone owner/user since the very first version came out 17 years ago. I've always loved all my iPhones, and I will continue to be an iPhone user for the rest of my life. This is in no way reflection on Apple iPhones whatsoever. They are an amazing and fantastic piece of technology. I think I just got a bad one for the first time in my life. Luckily, I have just checked and I have until November 6th to return this phone, and I WILL be returning it. Am I expected to buy a new one and get that shipped to me, transfer all my information from this phone to the new one, and then return this one? I am actually still paying for this phone on my Amazon Prime American Express card! Or, do I return this phone and wait until the refund has been issued and then buy another phone? Then wait until that is sent to me. I would not have a phone for at least a week in the interim, and we all know these days that's a practical impossibility. Like I said, I just had a total shoulder replacement surgery last Monday, September 9th, and have several upcoming follow up appointments, and physical therapy appointments. I also have several other non-related medical issues that definitely require that I have a phone. I just don't know what to do. Review Title: I needed a new phone fast after my cat knocked mine into the sink ☹️ Rice fixed it for a while, but
Review Content: I needed a new phone fast after my cat knocked mine into the sink ☹️ Rice fixed it for a while, but it was only temporary before it died altogether. I hate buying phones and avoid it whenever possible. 99% of mine belonged to someone in my family first. And i was good with that. Needless to say, my cat didn’t wait for someone in my family to upgrade. I was on my own this time. Okay.... that’s not entirely true. My grandma had an iPhone 7 sitting around so that held me over in the meantime. Going from an iPhone 11 Pro Max to an iPhone 7 was….bad. It was too dam small, in every possible way. 32 gigs of memory!! I needed an upgrade. Fast. My 11 year old was bullying me relentlessly. And that’s on me. They had my old XR (formerly my dad’s) I scoured FB marketplace. I’d decided upgrade a little, so I could feel better about the switch. I didn’t want to feel backed me into a corner by my cat’s recklessness. I would get a slightly newer model in a fun colour. Marketplace had plenty. Sending message after message from my iPhone 7, I worried. “This person seems too eager”, “this one has been posted so long”, “I want a purple, but the only purple one listed has less storage space” and “the pretty green one has a small crack”, “this guy lives 2 hours from me” and “Battery life? Errr last time I checked it was like 74%?….no, I can’t take a screenshot of it, it’s turned off”…. “cash only please” Etc. So much pressure. What happens if the thing doesn’t work? That’s $300+ down the drain. I knew I couldn’t afford new. But I hated the idea of buying something used from a stranger on Facebook. I didn’t want to get scammed, and I also didn’t want to settle. That’s when I remembered good ol’ Amazon. Maybe I’d check there. Just for funsies. Probably out of my budget, but it couldn’t hurt. Sure enough, refurbished devices selling “like new!” Mostly same cost or less than what I’d found so far. Surely there was a catch? I read through everything, tested by Amazon, includes all the specs, unlocked, I can pick the colour, the storage size, the condition, etc. AND I could have it delivered to me tomorrow??! With a warranty?!! I recovered from my brief stint of disappointment after learning the 12’s don’t come in yellow. Then fought hard to decide between mint and lavender. The lavender would take an extra day to arrive. Mint it was!! As promised, it arrived the next day. It was in beautiful shape. 128g’s, mint green, not a single scratch, 86% battery life. All for less than I would have paid to some stranger for a 64g with some “small scratches” Once my case and screen protector arrived I excitedly set it up and synced my data. After becoming used to facial recognition, having that yanked away, and dealing with a 7 for over 2 weeks— I was desperate for the convenience of Face ID. I had been using my fingerprint. Like a *caveman*. Not to mention I have Blink 182 tickets, and it specifically states facial recognition is required to access the mobile tickets. Idk if that’s true, but I needed Face ID!! I googled, I contacted apple support. Fixing it could be upwards of $300. That’s almost what I paid for the whole phone!! I realllllly didn’t want to be stuck without a phone again. But I also wanted one fully functioning. So I reached out to Amazon support and explained. The rep was incredibly helpful (as most Amazon reps are) and after bts failed, she advised the ship was a 3rd party seller, and she send a message to them. “If they don’t fix it by (insert date) contact us back and we’ll make this right” she encouraged. I’m ngl. I was nervous. I didn’t have high hopes, having dealt with 3p sellers on Amazon in the past. At least Amazon had my back, ig. The concert wasn’t till July. Even without facial recognition, it was loads better than the 7. I could make do in the meantime. The seller came in clutch though, and my worry was unwarranted. They responded within minutes. They were receptive, apologetic, and more than willing to help. As I’d anticipated, they offered a refund or exchange, as soon as they received the return. I explained my concern with not having a phone for several days or more; and the merchant offered to overnight a replacement as soon as the return was dropped off. I could deal with one day without a phone! I gratefully accepted. That was Saturday night, we made plans to catch up Monday for the return instructions and for them to overnight it. Monday I reached back out; and they were ready to ship, BUT they *had no more green….* 🫢 SHOCK THIS WAS A HUGE BUMMER.It’s silly I know, and the definition of *first world problems “.. but I mean…. My change of heart about this whole phone thing HINGED ON THE FUN COLOUR. Without it, I was just a person…out $350… because my cat was thirsty while I was watching YouTube while washing dishes. I needed a cool colour. Plus, I’d already gotten the matching case! Clear with mint green borders. It wasn’t even a fun blue… it was a dark, serious, navy blue. It was pretty and classy, but I wanted something fun. I even asked if he had any older models in yellow 😭😭 no luck, They told me they’d be restocking in a day or so. Still, no greens or purples came in. Ugh. Reality was setting in. I was going to have to settle. It was fine, I thought. At least it would be a fully functioning phone. No. I wasn’t ready to let go. They assured me I could take my time to decide, and I asked if we could wait another week in case one came in. If it didn’t, *then* I would choose from the options available. I messaged them Wednesday afternoon, bracing myself for the answer…. THEY GOT IN PURPLE! YAY. They sent a label, I dropped it off, sent a photo, and had my new phone the next morning. they’d said overnight shipping… but wow! I’d dropped off the return around 3pm, and had the replacement by noon the next day. I didn’t even have my new case yet 😅 Despite the Barney-Esque colour scheme my mint green case created, the lavender is GORGEOUS and I’m actually sort of glad the green didn’t work out. Don’t get me wrong, the green is also gorgeous.. but in the end I’m glad I ended up with the lavender. I was overjoyed when I was prompted to set Face ID during setup. Worked brilliantly, as did everything else. Great packaging, no cosmetic flaws, amazing battery life, customer service was great, and best of all… ITS PURPLE! Can’t wait to pair it with the new case. I’m so glad I went this route where I have some peace of mind as a buyer. I’m grateful to the seller for being so helpful and patient with me as insufferable as I must have seemed making such a fuss over colour preference If you’re nervous buying a phone used or refurbished too, hopefully you can take comfort in knowing- this seller is legit. You receive a good quality product, and, speaking from experience, they’ll gladly help resolve any issues you may run into. Review Title: However, this is the first time I’ve ever purchased a used/refurbished/ renewed pair
Review Content: However, this is the first time I’ve ever purchased a used/refurbished/ renewed pair. But since I lose them all the time, I thought it may be a cost effective option for me. Unfortunately, my device was defective out of the box! My Airpods Pro didn’t come with all of the materials that come in the original box and the charger I received [packaged separately] was not even an apple brand. This didn’t bother me much, as I have more than enough accessories for this item. The device itself appeared clean and undamaged. When I opened the device to check the battery status, it was dead [Apple has a policy of not sending their devices fully charged for shipping safety reasons, so I assumed the previous owner received the item new and returned them without charging it more]. I connected the airpods to my OFFICIAL Apple charger from a previous device and the battery light immediately glowed green. Confused, I then proceeded to pair it to my phone. The first attempt was successful. I checked my battery notification screen on my iPhone and the airpods case displayed a full 100% charge, yet the airpods themselves were each dead at 1%. After a few seconds of charge, they reached 7% [charging speed rare, but not completely unheard of], so I took the case off the charger and went to test out the sound quality. As soon as I took an earpiece out- the entire device went off. The case and pods still read as charging on my phone even though I had removed them from charging moments before. I could not find the devise in my drop menu, so I went into settings to manually pair the AirPods again- but they wouldn’t sync. After 4/5 times connecting and forgetting device, I attempted to reattach the charger- NOW the AirPods case is on 0% but the earpieces are both on 13% 🙄. As soon as I plug them back in, the airpods sync again and I am able to hear the pairing chime on my earpiece. SECONDS LATER the airpods die and the phone shows they are on 0% *charging* WHILE they are still in my ears! Like I said, I’ve had a ton of airpods, I know how to troubleshoot most any problem they give me. I’ve never had to deal with this kind of headache before- ESPECIALLY on day 1. I’m so over it! I’m going to an Apple store first thing in the morning. This was a horrible experience. Product Title: Amazon.com: Apple AirPods Pro (2nd Generation) (Renewed) : Electronics
Review Title: So, when I received these, I did not imagine it being boxed nicely
Review Content: So, when I received these, I did not imagine it being boxed nicely. But was I dead wrong. When I opened the Amazon packaging, I saw an Apple AirPods Pro boxed sealed and in pristine condition. I unwrapped it and opened the box and it was like opening a box for a pair of brand new AirPods. Everything down to the cable was properly placed and the headphones along with the case didn’t even look like they had been touched! AND THESE ARE RENEWED! It’s like I bought a pair brand new for less amount of money. A4C Online is absolutely amazing for how they packaged this product and the condition of these renewed AirPods Pro is beyond my belief. I truly didn’t expect the quality I received. As for the headphones themselves, jaw dropping amazement. From the noise cancellation, to the quality of the headphones, it’s all amazing. The noise cancellation is beyond belief. I set these up, put them in my ears while I listened to my fan, and turned on noise cancellation. Boom. The sound of the fan disappeared, like magic! The noise cancellation doesn’t block out every loud noise like movies, but it’s much better than anything I’ve ever used. Transparency is wonderful and definitely allows me to hear around me while I still listen to the music or video I’m listening to. I’m not sure if their are better headphones out there that do transparency better, but seeing how I’ve never seen headphones have this kind of feature, it’s definitely one of the reasons I bought these, especially so I can be at work and keep both headphones in without having to just leave one in so I may listen to what’s around me. The sound quality is crystal clear and makes me hear more of the music than I ever thought I could. The spatial sound turns music into a surround sound experience that was way better than I expected. The spatial sound was a little hard to setup, but that may just be because I’m an idiot. May take a few times, but you’ll get it eventually if you have the same problems I had. So far using these headphones, the only bad thing I can say about them is that the bass might be a little lower than I expected? But it’s not a big deal to me as I enjoy more of the quality of the sound rather than heavy bass, so if you really need to have heavy bass in your headphones, these might not be for you. As for the battery life, I haven’t had them long enough to know how well they are especially since these are also renewed. Thank you A4C Online for these wonderful headphones. I still cannot believe these are renewed headphones and am so glad I bought these from you! Thanks again. If you’re looking for a pair of AirPod Pros, you’re definitely making the right choice buying from them. The battery life is quite decent. After about 4 or 5 hours the battery life will drop to about 75%. Much more than I expected from a renewed product. Transparency is not as affective as I had originally thought. I have to turn down my music if I want to be able to hear anyone else. I wish they made it so you could increase the transparency to be louder otherwise I have to keep my music down low. Otherwise an excellent product still and I recommend buying these renewed AirPods.       [Read more Read less](javascript:void(0))

Their exceptional sound quality, comfortable fit, seamless integration, and convenient features make them a top-tier wireless earbud option. Whether you're an Apple enthusiast or simply looking for a premium audio experience, these refurbished AirPods Pro deliver on all fronts. Review Title: As a real hearing aid, something to hear others talk? For me, worthless
Review Content: As a real hearing aid, something to hear others talk? For me, worthless. I hear people better when I take them out. For that I should give 1 or 2 star rating. I hoped while my reg hearings were being repaired these would get me by. Nope. But. The sound quality for TV, computer, phone, and MUSIC! GREAT! I can enjoy music again. Our pellet stove is 8 feet away and noisy. The noise suppression all but blocks it out. The set up was super easy. I had my audiologist print out my hearing chart, or lack of hearing chart, took a pic with my I-phone, it quickly programed the Airpods and suddenly Janis Joplin sounded good again! Outside noise is blocked. I tried every ear pad that came with this and find the fit, ehh, so so. I have to be careful or they fall out. Left ear hurts after a half hour or so. Not the inner ear, but where it pushes on the cartridge. Getting used to it. Why did I keep them? Because of the sound quality when I do use them. Oh, and whoever designed the case after a greased water melon seed should be beat with something slick and hard to hold on to. A little embossed pattern on the case would have done a lot. And a better latch. If you drop these even a few inches the lid opens and the Airpods make a dash for the door. Dam near dropped one in the toilet. Caught it just in time. Luckily many aftermarket cases out there. And of course in Apple's weird system, a charger wasn't included and it takes a different one than my I-phone. Luckily I found one that fit and ordered a couple more. Youtube videos for how to set up are a must. I do have issues switching between my reg hearing aids and these, but usually not too bad. One time it's automatic, next time I'm in settings on my phone. But really not a big deal. Would be 5 star if they stayed in my ear and actually worked as a low grade hearing aid. But worth it for everything else. By programming like a hearing aid, sound quality is great!!! And blocking background noise is very nice. Might save on marriage counseling by not hearing each other. Review Title: I inspected it
Review Content: I inspected it. There are wear marks on the case and crown but the face was fine. I put a screen and case protector on it and it looks fine. I checked the battery life and it’s down to 85%. I’m sure that’s going to be fine. I know it can be replaced it I want to later. The sports band is not an Apple product but I don’t care. I quit buying Apple Watch bands years ago. I can buy 3 or 4 of these perfectly fine knockoffs for the price of one Apple. Other than the scuffs and battery it works as it should. Down with overpriced stuff and thumbs up for cheaper rebuilt semi quality stuff. Kinda like a rebuilt transmission. As for the functionality of the watch, it's fine except for the battery life. I have to charge it part way through the day IF I want it to last all day. On more than one occasion, by 4:00 pm, I got the 10% battery left message and then it is dead until I get it on a charger. Now, I'm going to have to spend $100 to get the battery replaced. AND - the watch charger that came with it, does not work. Yes, I took the piece of plastic off of it before trying it out. I'm beginning to regret my purchase. I guess I could see if I can replace the battery myself but I don't want to perform surgery on a piece of electronics at my age. The battery will be around $25 and the tool kit will be around $30 plus shipping and handling. Still saving money though. Maybe I can start a side hustle replacing apple watch batteries and save enough to go on vacation in the tropics or buy a small can of pineapple juice. Found a video tutorial that walked me through turning off a number of the functions of the watch to save on battery. I am pleased to report that after doing that, I can now wear it 10 or 11 hours and the watch will still have mid 70's battery left. I shouldn't have to do this but I did so Now I can wear it and not worry about taking a charger to work with me so I can charge it over my lunch break. Product Title: Amazon.com: Apple iPhone 14 Pro Max, 128GB, Space Black - Unlocked (Renewed) : Cell Phones & Accessories
Review Title: Unfortunately, the phone I received was nowhere near "Excellent
Review Content: Unfortunately, the phone I received was nowhere near "Excellent." The biggest issue is the camera system. One of the main reasons I chose the iPhone 14 Pro Max was for its three-camera setup. However, only one camera works properly in Photo mode. In Video mode, two cameras work, while the third doesn't work at all. The 0.5x ultra-wide camera is completely unavailable, and the 5x zoom function doesn't work either. This is especially frustrating because I'm an up-and-coming mechanic, and I regularly use the 0.5x camera to take photos in tight spaces while working on customers' vehicles. It's an important tool for my job, not just a feature I wanted. I upgraded from an iPhone 13 Pro Max where two of the cameras had failed, so I was excited to finally have a phone with all three cameras working. Instead, I ended up with another phone that has camera issues. At that point, I could have saved money by buying an iPhone 14 Plus with only two cameras and probably received a phone that actually worked. Another concern was that the phone was not properly factory reset. The packaging states that Amazon Renewed devices are supposed to be factory reset before being resold. However, when I powered it on, it started up like a normal phone instead of taking me through the initial setup process. It appeared the previous owner had simply signed out of their Apple ID rather than the phone being completely erased and reset. I contacted Amazon Customer Support to request a replacement since the phone was defective. I was told there were no more iPhone 14 Pro Max devices in Excellent condition available to send as a replacement. However, when I checked the same Amazon listing, it still showed the exact same phone in Excellent condition available for purchase. I don't understand why replacements weren't available when the listing indicated more were in stock. I would have been happy to return the defective phone in exchange for a properly functioning one. I understand that Amazon Renewed products are used, and I wasn't expecting a brand-new phone. However, I did expect to receive the condition I paid for and a device with all advertised features working correctly. A phone with a partially functioning camera system should never pass inspection as "Excellent," especially when customers are paying a premium for that condition. Overall, this experience was extremely disappointing. Amazon Renewed is supposed to give customers confidence that devices have been inspected and tested. Based on my experience, the inspection process failed, and customer service did not provide a reasonable solution. Review Content: It was a lovely phone, in outstanding cosmetic condition - it appeared brand new. Aside from the random shutdowns, my phone required charging every 3 hours, and within 2 weeks, the battery health dropped from 90% to 80%. It would have been an amazing deal and worth the money for a 1TB phone in great exterior condition , and I’m sad I had to return it . I could not handle the random shut downs and constant charging and the photo quality was also a big factor (it might just have been my phone and not all iPhone 14’s). I’m bummed! But return was easy & just a friendly reminder that whenever you do drop off a pricey item like this for returns, get a print out of the receipt ! Review Title: Needed to replace an aging IPhone which was still working great, but a lot of apps needing newer IOS
Review Content: Needed to replace an aging IPhone which was still working great, but a lot of apps needing newer IOS. So, not looking for the lastest/greatest, just a good update. Decided IPh 14+ was a good option. 1) I purchased an “Excellent” OPEN BOX phone from Best Buy. It came in a box sealed with Geek Squad tape. When opened, the phone had tons of fingerprints all over it, front and back; not a great first impression. After going through the startup process I was greeted with a screen that informed me that the phone had remote management software installed on it. Basically unusable. 2) I returned it and they replaced it with another “Excellent” OPEN BOX. Same thing – both phones had been previously owned by some company (now out of business) who had loaded remote management software on the phones. So… these are expensive, unusable bricks, and shame on BB/Geek Squad for selling these phones to the public. 3) After that experience I decided to give Amazon a try and bought a phone supplied by WOOT, as I have had good experiences with other Woot purchases. The phone arrived in a beat up generic box with the inside packaging worse than the outside. On the positive side, the phone was cosmetically very good with no obvious scratches, etc. So, everything looked good until I checked the battery health. 81%. NOT GOOD. Yes, it meets the described spec of >80% for their “Excellent” condition, but will going to be into the Apple service condition in a couple of weeks. Returned to Amazon/Woot and waiting for refund. After reading a ton of reviews I decided to give it one more shot and get a “Premium” condition directly from Amazon.com. Most of the reviews of these phones were much better than all of the other vendors. They are definitely more expensive but come with a 365 day warranty vs 90 day and spec at >90% battery life. Phone arrived today. It was VERY nicely packaged in a SEALED shrink wrapped professional looking box. Opened the box and found a phone with what appeared to be the original Apple protective film still in place on the front and back. Battery was dead so after a quick charge I was able to check battery health…… 100% and 0 charge cycles. Basically this is a brand NEW, NEVER USED phone. I can’t say how impressed I was after three bad experiences. I saved a couple $hundred compared to BB or Apple and got a brand new phone ….. It’s all about the journey  !!! Review Title: I ordered the iPhone 15 Pro Max refurbished and it arrived last night
Review Content: I ordered the iPhone 15 Pro Max refurbished and it arrived last night. After spending a good 3+ hours setting it up, I realized the lens for the main camera was broken. From the outside, you can’t see any issue. It wasn’t until I opened up the camera app that I actually saw it didn’t work. “Renewed Premium” carries a certain standard with it, and this certainly does not meet that in the slightest. On top of that, upon calling customer support, I was told that I would not be able to do anything unless I deactivated the phone and remove my Apple ID from it. Wouldn’t have been the end of the world if I needed to go back to my other phone for a bit, however, in order to set up this phone with the eSIM, deactivated my previous SIM card. Upon explaining all of that to customer support, I was told there was nothing they could do unless I deactivated this phone (leaving me without a phone until they received this and shipped me a new one) I was then told to call Apple to see what they can do, when honestly, this is their mistake. Either way, I called apple and it was going to be another set of hoops to jump through with scheduling appointments and all that. Plus since I didn’t have apple care, if they needed to repair the camera, I would still be without a phone. So even if Apple was able to help fix this, the issue of me not having a phone would still be there. Had I broken this camera myself - I would certainly except those terms given there’s not much else I could do. However, this was given to me in this condition and for Amazon to leave me with the responsibility of fixing their mistake due to carelessness in inspection and quality control is absurd. So whether I like it or not, I am now STUCK with the responsibility of cleaning this up since my account is connected to this phone now. What at one point could have been a great gift to myself has turned into the biggest hassle I’ve experienced buying/returning anything, probably ever. I’m going to give this one more shot as I’ve now ordered another iPhone from them to be delivered shortly, however, it’s also required me to spend another ~$1000 in having that iPhone sent prior to me getting my refund. This is absolutely ridiculous and unacceptable. Even if this next phone is perfect, I’m likely never going to order from the Amazon refurbished store again. I’ll either go straight to Apple refurbished, or brand new, for any of my future phone/laptop/device purchases. On top of all this hassle, I’ll certainly have to spend another few hours setting up my replacement phone once it arrives. All the time I’ve invested into this so far has NOT been even close worth the “nice discount” on a premium refurbished phone that should have arrived without issue to begin with. Amazon - take note. Change your policies. Making this the customer’s mess to clean up is not acceptable. I’ll plan to update this review if anything changes. But like I said, even if the next phone I ordered is perfect, I still give this a 1-star review for all the hassle and lack of responsibility the company took to resolve this. P.s. i’ll also add that I am a quite understanding and peaceful person. The person I spoke with from customer support was doing his absolute best to help me, but this was clearly a bigger issue than he had the power to solve. I requested to have this escalated to upper management and was told the same thing. Whoever is the one making decisions about what can and can’t be done needs to hear about this.
